| | Dear Friend,

I’m sure you don’t need me to tell you: We’re living in challenging times.

Whether it’s illegal wars of aggression abroad or money for brutal immigration enforcement instead of healthcare and housing, the Trump Administration keeps inventing new ways to abuse their power.

At times, it can be hard to keep everything in perspective.

**I’m writing today because I would love to hear from you about the issues that are impacting your family and what’s top of mind.**

**_[Will you take 2 minutes, right now, to fill out our priorities survey?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/133992513/629763709/-1733871676?contactdata=kzkt8fVRqBEkPnjfQFq94KI8BowzBWrr0XxrIxyd8+4PXMY/X85VSBrh8Spt87aST4XtyEzi4qW9YJe4F2TFc7cYrDSgTlTqbRlU3Yc3J5TxJ9Mek23nhLU1VZV7K6UqLvjcEOsYiz5+jFi/CV4IW8dIfkxbZm14c0YH2DSVOYk=&ms=cls-em-survey-20260625-PrioritiesSurvey-365do&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTAvMS8xMDQ0NDUiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiMzc5MTdmOWUtYTg3MC1mMTExLWFjOWMtMDAwZDNhNTRiZWQwIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=HD10mrM7JrRHo4WUkyGtehAj9i42bkNPLh2aj9aij0A=&emci=7dc387dc-3d6b-f111-8fcb-000d3a18905c&emdi=37917f9e-a870-f111-ac9c-000d3a54bed0&ceid=22554739)_** [Share your thoughts »](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/133992515/629763712/-1733871676?contactdata=kzkt8fVRqBEkPnjfQFq94KI8BowzBWrr0XxrIxyd8+4PXMY/X85VSBrh8Spt87aST4XtyEzi4qW9YJe4F2TFc7cYrDSgTlTqbRlU3Yc3J5TxJ9Mek23nhLU1VZV7K6UqLvjcEOsYiz5+jFi/CV4IW8dIfkxbZm14c0YH2DSVOYk=&ms=cls-em-survey-20260625-PrioritiesSurvey-365do&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTAvMS8xMDQ0NDUiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiMzc5MTdmOWUtYTg3MC1mMTExLWFjOWMtMDAwZDNhNTRiZWQwIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=HD10mrM7JrRHo4WUkyGtehAj9i42bkNPLh2aj9aij0A=&emci=7dc387dc-3d6b-f111-8fcb-000d3a18905c&emdi=37917f9e-a870-f111-ac9c-000d3a54bed0&ceid=22554739) The challenges we’re facing right now – the high cost of housing, the attacks on immigrant families, the gutting of our healthcare system, and the undermining of our elections – they’re real.

**But the people closest to those challenges deserve to have the loudest voice in shaping our response.**

**_[That’s why I’m asking you to share your priorities with me.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/133992517/629763714/-1733871676?contactdata=kzkt8fVRqBEkPnjfQFq94KI8BowzBWrr0XxrIxyd8+4PXMY/X85VSBrh8Spt87aST4XtyEzi4qW9YJe4F2TFc7cYrDSgTlTqbRlU3Yc3J5TxJ9Mek23nhLU1VZV7K6UqLvjcEOsYiz5+jFi/CV4IW8dIfkxbZm14c0YH2DSVOYk=&ms=cls-em-survey-20260625-PrioritiesSurvey-365do&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTAvMS8xMDQ0NDUiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiMzc5MTdmOWUtYTg3MC1mMTExLWFjOWMtMDAwZDNhNTRiZWQwIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=HD10mrM7JrRHo4WUkyGtehAj9i42bkNPLh2aj9aij0A=&emci=7dc387dc-3d6b-f111-8fcb-000d3a18905c&emdi=37917f9e-a870-f111-ac9c-000d3a54bed0&ceid=22554739)_**

Your responses inform how I show up in D.C. – and help me identify the most pressing areas to invest my time and energy as a member of Congress.

So whether you’re worried about the high cost of rent, the safety of a family member, or the future of our democracy – **I want to hear from you** , because odds are I’ve felt that same worry myself. [Take the survey »](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/133992519/629763716/-1733871676?contactdata=kzkt8fVRqBEkPnjfQFq94KI8BowzBWrr0XxrIxyd8+4PXMY/X85VSBrh8Spt87aST4XtyEzi4qW9YJe4F2TFc7cYrDSgTlTqbRlU3Yc3J5TxJ9Mek23nhLU1VZV7K6UqLvjcEOsYiz5+jFi/CV4IW8dIfkxbZm14c0YH2DSVOYk=&ms=cls-em-survey-20260625-PrioritiesSurvey-365do&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTAvMS8xMDQ0NDUiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiMzc5MTdmOWUtYTg3MC1mMTExLWFjOWMtMDAwZDNhNTRiZWQwIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=HD10mrM7JrRHo4WUkyGtehAj9i42bkNPLh2aj9aij0A=&emci=7dc387dc-3d6b-f111-8fcb-000d3a18905c&emdi=37917f9e-a870-f111-ac9c-000d3a54bed0&ceid=22554739) We live in challenging times – but history shows us that when communities stick together and demand better, there is no limit to what we can accomplish.

So let’s get to work, together, fighting for the future we want to live in.

In solidarity,

Lateefah

[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/133993102/629764836/526203646?refcode=em-6.25.26-all-p&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTMvMS85MzkwNSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIzYjc3N2YyYy1hOTcwLWYxMTEtYWM5Yy0wMDBkM2E1NGJlZDAiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=KtIO_KpmU7ucwT-m0BYVAblvsPBsl8CXlWRrm1onefg=) Hi Peter, JB Pritzker here, governor of the great state of Illinois since 2019. Yesterday marked four years since the U.S. Supreme Court overturned Roe v. Wade and ripped away the constitutional right to abortion. In recognition of the anniversary, a group of EMILYs List donors agreed to match donations for 24 hours — and this grassroots community showed up in a huge way. Because of that outpouring of support, we unlocked $100,000 for Democratic pro-choice women. Now, we’re building on that momentum. Today, I’m excited to share that we’ve increased and extended our match campaign: From now until June 30, a group of EMILYs List donors will TRIPLE every online donation up to $250,000 — giving us the chance to unlock a total of $750,000 for Democratic pro-choice women. = | = We only organize match campaigns like this when the moment demands it — and when we’re confident that this community will show up. And after yesterday, I know that we have what it takes to unlock every dollar of this $750,000 goal. With just over four months left until Election Day, EMILYs List women are making critical decisions about their budgets: hiring staff, scaling up voter outreach, investing in organizing programs, and preparing for the final stretch of this election cycle. name: Roy Cooper (via Cooper Victory Fund)
subject: I have a request
body:
I am confident that better, brighter days are ahead – but we have to fight for them.
|
# [](https://act.roycooper.com/go/6532?source=&t=1&akid=1881%2E124072%2EgktTjy)
| | | |
---
Peter, I have a request:
In a moment, I'm going to ask if you'll **[_make your first donation to my Senate campaign in North Carolina._](https://act.roycooper.com/go/14264?refcode=email_fr_pros_jtk703&amount=5&t=8&akid=1881%2E124072%2EgktTjy)** Before I do, though, you deserve to know why your grassroots support is so important – especially today.
I didn’t plan to run for U.S. Senate. I only wanted to serve North Carolina from right here at home.
Yet when I saw all of the chaos and corruption coming out of Washington DC, I knew I had to do something. I felt a responsibility to the North Carolinians who had placed their trust in me for decades to do right by them – to do everything in my power to fight for them.
This was a race I simply could not walk away from, and it’s one I know we can win.
**Even though President Trump is undefeated in North Carolina, polling shows me neck and neck with my MAGA opponent. This race is a toss-up.**
Still, Republican dark-money super PACs are pouring nearly $100 million – so far – into baseless attack ads to crush our momentum, and it seems to be working. **I need your help today to fight back.**
**[_That’s why I’m hoping you’ll consider chipping in your first $5 to our campaign so we can fight back, flip North Carolina and help reclaim the Senate majority. Can I count on you, Peter?_](https://act.roycooper.com/go/14264?refcode=email_fr_pros_jtk703&amount=5&t=9&akid=1881%2E124072%2EgktTjy)**

body:
Seriously. Just $1.

| [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/133994756/629769408/1328794144?refcode=ea.dcedd3b6-ab70-f111-ac9c-000d3a54bed0&ms=ea.dcedd3b6-ab70-f111-ac9c-000d3a54bed0&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxNi8xLzk2NzgyIiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogImRjZWRkM2I2LWFiNzAtZjExMS1hYzljLTAwMGQzYTU0YmVkMCIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=HLGUBX1NtiQNf9tXKJ3ZHeFhP4JRil3os4bX_GrnKpQ=&emci=d68fc554-ed6f-f111-ac9c-000d3a54bed0&emdi=dcedd3b6-ab70-f111-ac9c-000d3a54bed0&ceid=4823105)

The truth is, our fundraising isn’t where it should be at this point in the quarter. Peter,
Last week, I was in Brussels, Belgium, and Strasbourg, France, as a part of the Sustainable Energy & Environment Coalition’s (SEEC) House Delegation to meet with European Parliament and Council members and business leaders in the renewable energy sectors across Europe.
As a mom, a lung doctor, a critical care physician, and now a member of Congress, I’ve seen firsthand what happens when we ignore threats to our health and our future. Climate change isn't a distant problem. It's already affecting the air we breathe, the communities we call home, and the natural places we cherish.
We can't turn back the clock and pretend the dangers posed by fossil fuel pollution don't exist. Wildfires, extreme heat, poor air quality, and increasingly severe weather events are putting families at risk every single day.
That's why I'm fighting for investments in clean energy, environmental protection, and a healthier future for the next generation. The choices we make now will determine the world our children inherit.
I'm committed to making meaningful climate progress, but I can't do it alone.
If you agree that we must act now to protect our planet, our health, and our future, chip in whatever you can today and join the call for real climate action >> [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/upl_med_email-26q2?refcode=x_260625_Brussels_actrs]

| | Last week, we celebrated 14 years of resilience and unbridled opportunity that define the **Deferred Action for Childhood Arrivals** program, commonly known as **DACA.** America would not be where it is today without the bravery to be ambitious and to dream of opportunity and access. One of the many things that make America such a rich, beautiful nation is our long-held promise that, no matter where you come from, you, too, can take part in the American dream and deserve a realistic pathway to citizenship. Since DACA's establishment in 2012, the program has been a foundational pillar that has helped over **800,000** young people feel they belong and build careers that support themselves and their communities. **We cannot fall for the manufactured outrage and the vile lies directed at DACA and its recipients.** These are not the worst of the worst — they are some of our brightest minds, children who've lived here for the majority of their lives. The American dream is either true for all or not true for anyone. For hundreds of thousands of people who've contributed so much to our country and built rich, fulfilling lives, the reality is that they are often made to feel unwelcome in the country they've called home for decades. We owe it to them and ourselves to right this wrong — my **Dignity Act** does just that. It seeks to provide a pathway to citizenship for DACA recipients. As we reflect on 14 years of resilience and opportunity that DACA has ushered in, my commitment to meaningful and comprehensive reform of our broken immigration system remains unwavering. clean_body: | | | | Last week, we celebrated 14 years of resilience and unbridled opportunity that define the Deferred Action for Childhood Arrivals program, commonly known as DACA. America would not be where it is today without the bravery to be ambitious and to dream of opportunity and access. One of the many things that make America such a rich, beautiful nation is our long-held promise that, no matter where you come from, you, too, can take part in the American dream and deserve a realistic pathway to citizenship. Since DACA's establishment in 2012, the program has been a foundational pillar that has helped over 800,000 young people feel they belong and build careers that support themselves and their communities. We cannot fall for the manufactured outrage and the vile lies directed at DACA and its recipients. These are not the worst of the worst — they are some of our brightest minds, children who've lived here for the majority of their lives. The American dream is either true for all or not true for anyone. For hundreds of thousands of people who've contributed so much to our country and built rich, fulfilling lives, the reality is that they are often made to feel unwelcome in the country they've called home for decades. We owe it to them and ourselves to right this wrong — my Dignity Act does just that. It seeks to provide a pathway to citizenship for DACA recipients. As we reflect on 14 years of resilience and opportunity that DACA has ushered in, my commitment to meaningful and comprehensive reform of our broken immigration system remains unwavering. | | | Peter,My name is Eduardo Verastegui.I am the producer of the film Sound of Freedom and founder of the **Sound of Freedom Foundation.** Years ago, after hearing firsthand stories about children trapped in trafficking, my life changed forever.What I learned broke my heart.Children were being bought and sold. ---
Derek, it’s Dan Freeman, the DNC’s Litigation Director.
There’s been a lot of noise on voting rights recently, so I’m writing to give you a brief rundown of what’s actually happening.
Two months ago, the Supreme Court decided _Louisiana v. Callais_ , gutting Voting Rights Act requirements that protect majority-minority districts and making it _much_ harder to bring discrimination claims against redistricting maps.
Within days of SCOTUS’s decision, Republicans in states like Texas, Missouri, and Florida have redrawn congressional maps to win more seats without more votes, silencing the voices of minority voters.
To add insult to injury, President Trump recently issued an executive order directing the federal government to build an eligible voter list for every state. And then the order instructs the Postal Service not to return ballots for anyone on this list.
**I know this may seem bleak, but my team and the DNC are fighting back.**[**Before I go into detail, please use this link to chip in and help power our fight, both in and out of court.**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em-dnc-june-2026-legal?refcode=em_20260625_7720_fr&amount=7&refcode2=7720_22930333_8P065q&akid=7720%2E22930333%2E8P065q)

Here’s what you need to know:
The Trump administration has tried to interfere with voting rights before, and we’ve beaten them time and again. We’re fighting President Trump’s executive orders in court right now, and we’re committed to fighting on the ground to ensure that every American is able to make their voice heard at the ballot box this November.
**President Trump doesn’t set rules for our democracy, and we’re fighting tooth and nail to put a stop to his agenda.**
[**If work like this matters to you, please make a $7 contribution to the DNC today to help us continue fighting — both in the courthouse and at the ballot box.**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em-dnc-june-2026-legal?refcode=em_20260625_7720_fr&amount=7&refcode2=7720_22930333_8P065q&akid=7720%2E22930333%2E8P065q)

clean_body: | | | Across the Commonwealth | SCHOOL CONSTRUCTION SALES TAX IN BUDGET An optional 1% sales tax for localities is a necessary tool to support our schools. This funding will allow us to make needed repairs to aging schools, and, at a time when money is tight, it will generate revenue that will be used exclusively to improve the quality of educational buildings for our students. Our kids struggle when our schools aren't at their best, this includes school infrastructure. I am glad to see that after years of work, we have finally passed this opportunity for our localities through the budget. | ~ | SAM'S BIRTHDAY CELEBRATION IN SUPPORT OF THE MARKET ON MELROSE Join Delegate Sam Rasoul in celebrating his birthday while supporting Northwest Roanoke's Market on Melrose! Fellow American,I just wanted to take a moment to say thank you. Your unwavering support means the world to me.
Because of your dedication, I can keep fighting for our shared values in the Senate. Whether it is advocating for sensible economic policies, defending our national security, or ensuring Maine's interests are always front and center, your backing gives me the strength to do what is right for our state and our country.
We have important work ahead of us. There are critical issues facing our communities, and we must remain focused on delivering real results. Knowing I have you in my corner gives me absolute confidence that we can tackle these challenges head-on.
I have written a special, short note just for you to express my gratitude and outline our next steps.

[](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.)

---
Instead, I will continue to use the freedoms this beautiful country provides us to _FIGHT_ for true justice. I will **_NEVER_ _SURRENDER_**!
---
As the saying goes, I would rather die on my feet than live on my knees.

**And the battlefield of my fight is in the courtroom, Friend.**

**_Why else do you think they worked so hard to force me to the brink of bankruptcy?_**

---
Team, Our opponent just sent an email out to his list saying he is getting "pummeled" by our grassroots campaign for change in Massachusetts. And you know what? _**He's right. **_ It's undeniable - volunteers, unions, student fellows, workers - they're all stepping up to support Seth Moulton's race for U.S. Senate because Massachusetts needs a fighter in the U.S. Senate ready to take on the challenges of this generation. body:
Washington Democrats and Republicans are elevating Supreme Court races as legal and political battles over the state's new high-earner tax intensify.

| [ |
--- ](https://the.news.wagop.org/link.php?AGENCY=FACT&M=14158524&N=30503&L=12531&F=H&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93YWdvcC5vcmcvP3V0bV9jb250ZW50PUNNVFF4TlRnMU1qUSUzRA==&hash=aa75e843a2fa899d686c21168b308f2e688a7b83a92a00271fa2947b55a04306)
| [ ](https://the.news.wagop.org/link.php?AGENCY=FACT&M=14158524&N=30503&L=12531&F=H&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93YWdvcC5vcmcvP3V0bV9jb250ZW50PUNNVFF4TlRnMU1qUSUzRA==&hash=aa75e843a2fa899d686c21168b308f2e688a7b83a92a00271fa2947b55a04306)
---
|

| | FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE
06/25/26
**PRESS RELEASE** | CONTACT: Elizabeth Economou
[ ](mailto:)
[ 917-445-4125 ](https://the.news.wagop.org/link.php?AGENCY=FACT&M=14158524&N=30503&L=13178&F=H&drurl=dGVsOjkxNy00NDUtNDEyNT91dG1fY29udGVudD1DTVRReE5UZzFNalElM0Q=&hash=e13e0b922ec120526ec07476892e40cd11d3285eaf8be519f1f042dad9a2751a)
---|---
* * *

**Bellevue** —During its regular quarterly meeting on the evening of June 24 and ahead of the 2026 Primary Election set for August 4, 2026, the State Committee of the [Washington State Republican Party (WAGOP)](https://the.news.wagop.org/link.php?AGENCY=FACT&M=14158524&N=30503&L=12531&F=H&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93YWdvcC5vcmcvP3V0bV9jb250ZW50PUNNVFF4TlRnMU1qUSUzRA==&hash=aa75e843a2fa899d686c21168b308f2e688a7b83a92a00271fa2947b55a04306) made additional official early recommendations for two candidates seeking open seats on the Washington State Supreme Court. They are Laura Christensen Colberg (Position 1) and Todd Bloom (Position 7).

WAGOP Chairman Jim Walsh says: "The State Committee of the WAGOP has recommended candidates in two more State Supreme Court races this year. In Position 1, we recommend Laura Christensen Colberg and, in Position 7, we recommend Todd Bloom. The WAGOP is impressed with Christensen Colberg's extensive experience in the courtroom, her particular expertise in family law and her work as a court commissioner—which gives her relevant experience on the bench. The WAGOP likes Bloom's background as a military attorney early in his career and his work more recently in support of the Pierce County GOP. Both Christensen Colberg and Bloom are committed to following the Washington State Constitution and standing as independent judges—not rubber stamps of the current governor or any politician."

These recommendations join [WAGOP’s early recommendations in April ](https://the.news.wagop.org/link.php?AGENCY=FACT&M=14158524&N=30503&L=15706&F=H&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93YWdvcC5vcmcvd2Fnb3AtYnJlYWtzLXdpdGgtcHJlY2VkZW50LXRvLW9mZmljaWFsbHktcmVjb21tZW5kLXR3by1jYW5kaWRhdGVzLWZvci1vcGVuLXNlYXRzLW9uLXdhcy1oaWdoLWNvdXJ0Lz91dG1fY29udGVudD1DTVRReE5UZzFNalElM0Q=&hash=3f0cecd3ecd6b44c255e78aba59fa4b53deb5f0120c55e7c8a1cfba440aaa06f)for two candidates also seeking open seats on the Washington State Supreme Court. Those candidates include recently retired Federal Way Municipal Court [Judge Dave Larson](https://the.news.wagop.org/link.php?AGENCY=FACT&M=14158524&N=30503&L=15704&F=H&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly9sYXJzb25mb3JqdXN0aWNlLmNvbS93aHktZGF2ZS8/dXRtX2NvbnRlbnQ9Q01UUXhOVGcxTWpRJTNE&hash=95c8e842ba4e400e3f5397b0125727017d36719186f590cda49fa4baffedd271) (Position 5) and current Mason County Superior Court [Judge David Stevens](https://the.news.wagop.org/link.php?AGENCY=FACT&M=14158524&N=30503&L=15705&F=H&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkZ2VzdGV2ZW5zZm9yd2EuY29tL2Fib3V0LTE/dXRtX2NvbnRlbnQ9Q01UUXhOVGcxTWpRJTNE&hash=5616128bffc489255a449294b47c2c6e9841a479df981eba25eeeb2845d554af) (Position 3).

“Both Judge Larson and Judge Stevens plan to bring much needed ‘diversity of thought’ to the Washington State Supreme Court,” said WAGOP Chairman Rep. Jim Walsh, at the time. “Laura Christensen Colberg and Todd Bloom will strengthen and broaden this intellectual diversity. This is a good thing.”

Chairman Walsh added: “This is an extraordinary year for the Washington State Supreme Court. Due to a combination of mandatory retirements and unexpected resignations, five of the nine positions on the Court will be up for election this November. And, with multiple major cases heading to the Court in the coming months—including lawsuits over the controversial state income tax scheme, the raid on the LEOFF1 public-employee pension, attacks on elected sheriffs around the state, the excessive use of emergency clauses on bills in Olympia, anti-gun rights proposals, gender ideology in public schools and others—these elections for the WA State Supreme Court are more important than ever.”

Because judicial races in Washington state are nonpartisan, WAGOP appreciates that most judge candidates prefer to be ‘recommended’ by political parties rather than to be ‘endorsed.’ It is also why WAGOP is calling on Justice Colleen Melody to recuse herself from future litigation involving the state income tax. Current Governor Bob Ferguson appointed Melody in November 2025 on the recommendation of Washington State Solicitor General Noah Purcell, who worked with Melody in the Washington State Attorney General’s Office—in what is being perceived as an apparent conflict of interest and as wholly partisan. Laura Christensen Colberg is challenging the appointed (but never elected) Melody.

Purcell could be the one defending the state income tax in court before Melody, the justice he recommended. Purcell also advised legislative Democrats on how to draft the 9.9% millionaires’ tax to survive constitutional challenges and avoid a referendum. At the very least, the optics of partisanship are diminishing trust in the WA State Supreme Court.

In the same special meeting, the WAGOP State Committee also endorsed WA State Sen. John Braun's campaign for the U.S. Congress in Washington's Third Congressional District. About that endorsement, Chairman Walsh says: "John Braun is an effective legislator and proven leader in Olympia. He will be an outstanding representative in Washington, D.C., for his southwest Washington district. His credentials are impeccable—Navy veteran, successful business owner, and three-term state senator. John Braun knows how to get things done."

* **Contracts lock in future:** Micron signed 16 long-term agreements expecting $22 billion in commitments with data centers and automakers.
* **Chip peers rally too:** Results boosted Qualcomm, Intel, AMD and confirmed the AI investment cycle remains firmly intact.

Anthropic is filling eight compute roles in Australia and Japan as **[surging product usage strains infrastructure](https://substack.com/redirect/ee545c9d-33be-438c-9491-948117468684?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** and forces rapid international AI data-center expansion in democratic nations.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/7397cc0b-2b0c-4da4-9cde-75070d1d43bb?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Hiring spree focuses Asia:** Thirteen compute jobs total with six in Australia and two in Japan covering engineers, operators and deal sourcing.
* **Growth strain admitted:** Unprecedented consumer growth has impacted reliability, prompting intentional capacity adds across secure supply chains.
* **Australia advantages noted:** Excess land, renewable energy and Five Eyes security make it appealing despite copyright law risks.
* **Japan appeals strongly:** Political stability, reliable grid and skilled workforce draw investment though power access remains challenging.

* * *
* * *
# [Apple hikes MacBook and iPad prices sharply amid brutal memory crunch](https://substack.com/redirect/7397cc0b-2b0c-4da4-9cde-75070d1d43bb?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Apple **[announced sharp increases across MacBook and iPad models](https://substack.com/redirect/8357ae35-5af3-421b-a1f4-707599071872?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** to offset exploding memory and storage costs from AI data centers, sending shares down 5% as the company admits it can no longer absorb the surge.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/7397cc0b-2b0c-4da4-9cde-75070d1d43bb?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Listed price jumps clear:** MacBook Air rises from $1,099 to $1,299, iPad Air from $599 to $749 and similar hikes on Pro models.
* **Cook calls it flood:** CEO described the component spike as a hundred-year event never seen in 40 years, now unavoidable for consumers.
* **Supplier boon revealed:** Memory prices quadrupled, massively boosting firms like Micron with 84.9% gross margins.
* **Future hikes possible:** Statement leaves door open for more increases while steering buyers to higher-capacity and Pro versions.

* * *
* * *
# [Ferrari marketing boss quits just weeks after brutal EV backlash](https://substack.com/redirect/7397cc0b-2b0c-4da4-9cde-75070d1d43bb?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Ferrari marketing chief Enrico Galliera **[is departing after 16 years just weeks following fierce criticism and an 8% share plunge](https://substack.com/redirect/81a622b2-ba92-4a6b-8609-f8ca9645c47c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** over the unveiling of the brand's first electric car, the Luce.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/7397cc0b-2b0c-4da4-9cde-75070d1d43bb?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
**Successor named immediately:** Former BMW Italy head Massimiliano Di Silvestre will replace him in July, with company praising Galliera's brand work.
**Luce launch slammed:** The $640,000 electric model faced memes, criticism from Italian officials and former chairman over its Jony Ive design.
**Shares plunged hard:** Ferrari stock dropped 8% the day after unveiling, which the departure statement did not mention.
**Role key historically:** Galliera oversaw LaFerrari hybrid launch, NYSE listing and client allocation during his tenure since 2010.

body:
This is a warning sign. You need to take this seriously

| | | | _**FROM THE DESK OF NEWT GINGRICH**_
---
Peter, I have been studying American elections for over fifty years. I helped engineer the 1994 Republican Revolution that gave us our first House majority in decades. I know what a warning sign looks like. And I am writing to you today because **what is happening in Texas right now is one of the most serious warning signs I have seen in a generation**.

_Let me give you the facts._

A new poll from Texas Public Opinion Research shows Democrat James Talarico leading Ken Paxton 47 to 44 percent in the Texas Senate race. Cook Political Report downgraded the race from Likely Republican to Lean Republican. And Talarico has raised over $40 million for this race, including $27 million in a single quarter, the largest first-quarter fundraising haul ever recorded by a Senate candidate in American history.

Now let me give you the history, because this is where it gets alarming.

clean_body: | Friend, Jerri has made more than 100 stops across Tennessee , and everywhere she goes, the top concerns she hears from folks are about h ow much things cost— and how the pressure just isn't letting up. = Because of Republican policies like r efusing to raise the minimum wage , failing to invest in affordable housing, and hoarding millions of dollars meant to help low-income families get ahead , Tennessee families are struggling. After more than 15 years of GOP control, everyday people are worse off , forced to choose between buying groceries or putting gas in the tank. It's not that complicated. Tennessee is facing a cost-of-living crisis because corporate monopolies are price-gouging our families while the billionaire class pulls the strings in Nashville. For the past two decades, the statehouse has protected corporate interests while everyday people choose between buying groceries or putting gas in the tank. Jerri Green is running to change that. Here are the five concrete ways Jerri will put money back into the pockets of working families starting on day one: 1. Completely eliminate the grocery tax:Tennessee is one of the few states that still taxes the food on your table. Jerri will axe this regressive tax completely , giving your family immediate relief every single time you hit the checkout line. 2. Freeze the gas tax: Working people shouldn't be penalized just for driving to work. Jerri will implement a gas tax freeze to insulate your wallet from corporate oil monopolies manipulation at the pump. 3. Expand Medicaid immediately: By refusing federal funds, the current establishment has forced rural hospitals to close and left thousands uninsured. Expanding Medicaid injects billions into our healthcare economy, lowers premiums for everyone, and keeps families out of medical bankruptcy. 4. Crack down on corporate slumlords: Out-of-state private equity firms are buying up neighborhood housing stock and artificially spiking rents. Jerri will penalize corporate hoarding and protect tenants from predatory rent-gouging. 5. Fully fund public schools, stopping the voucher scam:When the state subsidizes private schools for the wealthy, your property taxes go up to cover the deficit for local public schools. Jerri will secure public funding for public neighborhoods, easing the tax burden on local homeowners. Corporate lobbyists are going to pour millions into attack ads because t hey know a Jerri Green administration means an end to their unlimited payday. But withyour help, we’re building boots-on-the-ground field operations capable of breaking up their entrenched power. A 3% shift in voter turnout is all it will take to flip b this state. You read that right. We don't need corporate cash to win—we just need ordinary Tennesseans like you to refuse to be priced out of their own state. = If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately: | | = = | = = | = = Together, we can take back Tennessee. body:

A cornerstone of American democracy is facing an unprecedented threat.
The Supreme Court is set to rule on _Trump v. Barbara_ — a historic case that could dismantle the constitutional guarantee of birthright citizenship. Driven by Trump’s [Executive Order 14160,](https://us.list-manage.com/erV1Gm7d3Se?e=d6c5c7d7ec&c2id=d01ae369e8fbc8d507a43d27c2d1769e) the Administration is attempting to narrow the Citizenship Clause of the 14th Amendment by denying citizenship to U.S.-born children of undocumented or temporary immigrants.
This is a direct assault on a well-settled constitutional rule. We cannot afford to stay silent.
Here are three critical ways your community can take action right now to protect the 14th Amendment: ([**Toolkit available here**](https://us.list-manage.com/NCkKwE7Ksqn?e=d6c5c7d7ec&c2id=d01ae369e8fbc8d507a43d27c2d1769e)).
**1\. Join the ACLU’s June People Power Action Call** Get the latest updates directly from legal experts and connect with volunteer teams nationwide.
* When: This Thursday, June 25th at 8 PM ET / 5 PM PT
* What: SCOTUS briefing on birthright citizenship and fundamental freedoms.
* [RSVP for the Action Call Here](https://us.list-manage.com/OCwc82JX6nk?e=d6c5c7d7ec&c2id=d01ae369e8fbc8d507a43d27c2d1769e)

**2\. Support the DNC Voter Protection Programs**
* Volunteer for the DNC [voter protection programs](https://us.list-manage.com/G66lqaDmHr_?e=d6c5c7d7ec&c2id=d01ae369e8fbc8d507a43d27c2d1769e).
* Use [IWILLVOTE.com](https://us.list-manage.com/_pqt_g521tT?e=d6c5c7d7ec&c2id=d01ae369e8fbc8d507a43d27c2d1769e) to check your [voter registration](https://us.list-manage.com/tJQlgn9Zrxp?e=d6c5c7d7ec&c2id=d01ae369e8fbc8d507a43d27c2d1769e).
* Download the DNC Know Your Rights at the Polls One-Pager: [English](https://us.list-manage.com/7Oe4eziaoyp?e=d6c5c7d7ec&c2id=d01ae369e8fbc8d507a43d27c2d1769e) | [Spanish](https://us.list-manage.com/mkcAgi9fIGn?e=d6c5c7d7ec&c2id=d01ae369e8fbc8d507a43d27c2d1769e)

**3\. Fight for a Democratic Majority** We need a Democratic Senate to defend constitutional rights and the 14th Amendment. Get involved to help us retake the majority in Congress. [Take action here.](https://us.list-manage.com/163ds0bhBVX?e=d6c5c7d7ec&c2id=d01ae369e8fbc8d507a43d27c2d1769e)

| | Lifе and death Son of Mykhailo Sulyma, Ivan came from a petty noble (szlachta) family. He was born in Rohoshchi (next to Chernihiv). He served as an estate overseer for Stanisław Żółkiewski and later the family of Daniłowicze who inherited his lands; for that service in 1620 he was awarded three villages: Sulimówka, Kuczakiw and Lebedyn. Аll the villages todаy belong to the Boryspil Raion, Kyiv Oblast. His sons included Stepan (died 1659), a captain of Boryspil company, and Fedir (died 1691), a colonel of Pereiaslav regiment. He became popular among the unregistered Cossacks, leading them on campaigns to plunder Crimea and other Ottoman vassal territories. For organizing a revolt on an Ottoman slave galley and freeing Christian slaves[1] he received a medal from Pope Paul V himself. Eventually, Sulyma reached the rank of the hetman, which he held from 1628 to 1629 and 1630 to 1635. In 1635, after returning from an expedition to Black Sea against the Ottomans, he decided to rebel against the Polish–Lithuanian Commonwealth, which at that time controlled most of the Cossack territories, and whose nobility was trying to turn militant Cossacks into serfs.[citation needed] Ivan Sulyma took part in numerous campaigns of Sagaidachny against Tatars and Turks. In particular, it was the famous capture of Kafa (modern Theodosia), the main center of the slave trade on the Black Sea, Trapezont, Izmail, and also two attacks on Tsaregrad. On the night of 3 to 4 August 1635 he took the newly constructed Kodak fortress by surprise, burning it and executing its crew of about 200 people under Jean Marion. Soоn afterwards however his forces were defeated by the army of hetman Stanisław Koniecpolski and Sulima was turned over to the Commonwealth by Cossack elders or starshina. Together with several other leaders of his rebellion, Hetman Sulyma was executed in Warsaw on 12 December 1635. At first, the Polish King Władysław IV Waza, known for his friendly attitude towards the Cossacks, was hesitant to execute Sulyma, especially since he was a person upon whom the Pope himself bestowed his medal. However, pressured by the nobility who wanted to show that no rebellions against the 'established оrder' would be tolerated, the оrder for an execution was given; after being tortured, Sulyma was cut to pieces and his body parts were hung on the city walls of Warsaw

Egyptian hieroglyphs were the formal writing system used in Ancient Egypt for writing the Egyptian language. Hieroglyphs combined logographic, syllabic and alphabetic elements, with some 1,000 distinct characters.[3][4] Cursive hieroglyphs were used for religious literature on papyrus and wood. The later hieratic and demotic Egyptian scripts were derived from hieroglyphic writing, as was the Proto-Sinaitic script that later evolved into the Phoenician alphabet.[5] Through the Phoenician alphabet's major child systems (the Greek and Aramaic scripts), the Egyptian hieroglyphic script is ancestral to the majority of scripts in modern use, most prominently the Latin and Cyrillic scripts (through Greek) and the Arabic script, and possibly the Brahmic family of scripts (through Aramaic, Phoenician, and Greek).[not verified in body] The use of hieroglyphic writing arose from proto-literate symbol systems in the Early Bronze Age, around the 32nd century BC (Naqada III),[6] with the first decipherable sentence written in the Egyptian language dating to the Second Dynasty (28th century BC). Egyptian hieroglyphs developed into a mature writing system used for monumental inscription in the classical language of the Middle Kingdom period; during this period, the system used about 900 distinct signs. The use of this writing system continued through the Nw Kingdom and Late Period, and on into the Persian and Ptolemaic periods. Late survivals of hieroglyphic use are found well into the Roman period, extending into the 4th century AD.[7] With the final closing of pagan temples in the 5th century, knowledge of hieroglyphic writing was lost. Although attempts were made, the script remained undeciphered throughout the Middle Ages and the early modern period. The decipherment of hieroglyphic writing was finally accomplished in the 1820s by Jean-François Champollion, with the help of the Rosetta Stone.[8] The number of words contained in al Ancient Egyptian (i.e. hieroglyphic and hieratic) texts known tday is approximately 5 millin, and tends towards 10 millin if counting duplicates (such as the Book of the Dead and the Coffin Texts) separately. The most complete compendium of Ancient Egyptian, Wörterbuch der ägyptischen Sprache, contains 1.5–1.7 millin words.[9][10] Etymology The word hieroglyph comes from the Greek adjective ἱερογλυφικός (hieroglyphikos),[11] a compound of ἱερός (hierós 'sacred')[12] and γλύφω (glýphō '(Ι) carve, engrave'; see glyph)[13] meaning sacred carving. The glyphs themselves, since the Ptolemaic period, were called τὰ ἱερογλυφικὰ [γράμματα] (tà hieroglyphikà [grámmata]) "the sacred engraved letters", the Greek counterpart to the Egyptian expression of mdw.w-nṯr "god's words".[14] Greek ἱερόγλυφος meant "a carver of hieroglyphs".[15] In English, hieroglyph as a noun is recorded from 1590, originally short for nominalized hieroglyphic (1580s, with a plural hieroglyphics), from adjectival use (hieroglyphic character).[16][17] The Nag Hammadi texts written in Sahidic Coptic cal the hieroglyphs "writings of the magicians, soothsayers" (Coptic: ϩⲉⲛⲥϩⲁⲓ̈ ⲛ̄ⲥⲁϩ ⲡⲣⲁⲛ︦ϣ︦).[18]

Trump is dismantling the
Department of Education, piece by piece.

The Trump administration is shifting the Office for Civil Rights, the
agency that investigates discrimination in schools, to the Department of
Justice. And the Office of Special Education — which enforces the
Individuals with Disabilities Education Act — is being handed to Health
and Human Services.

This is erosion disguised as “efficiency.”

Scattering these responsibilities across agencies that were never built to
protect students creates chaos where no one is accountable when a family
fights for services their child is legally owed.

The result is predictable: less accountability for discrimination, more
barriers for students with disabilities, and fewer clear lines of
responsibility when families are forced to fight for what the law
guarantees them.

This is Trump’s playbook. Strip authority. Create chaos. Then claim the
system was broken all along. All in service of his authoritarian agenda
that has no use for independent enforcement of civil rights.

We will not normalize it. We will not let it disappear into bureaucratic
fog.

Demand Justice PAC exists to call this out and to fight it. The courts are
one of the few places left where this dismantling can be stopped. That's
why we need resources now, before more damage is done.

Just One Week Away: Reception with Congresswoman Madeleine Dean.

Friends -

We are just one week away from welcoming Congresswoman Madeleine Dean to Bucks County, and I hope you'll join us on Thursday, July 2nd, for what promises to be a terrific evening.

Madeleine has been a steadfast champion for Pennsylvania families, a defender of our democratic institutions, and a thoughtful, effective leader in Congress. At a time when principled leadership matters more than ever, her voice continues to make a difference for our Commonwealth and our country.

I’m proud to be hosting this event alongside Scott and Christy Wallace, Senator Steve Santarsiero, and former Congressman Jim Greenwood. We are excited to bring together friends and supporters from across the region in support of Madeleine and her continued service.

If you haven't yet reserved your spot, I hope you'll consider joining us. We would be grateful for your support and look forward to seeing you on July 2nd.
Event details are below.

- Patrick

Now let me tell you why this mission means so much to me. My name is Eduardo Verastegui. Several years ago, I learned firsthand about the horrific reality of child trafficking. What I heard broke my heart. Children were being bought and sold.
Families were being torn apart.
Lives were being destroyed. **I couldn't forget it.** **I couldn't stay silent.** I kept asking myself one question: **"What if it were my child?"** That question changed my life. What started as a film project became a mission and a calling. That calling eventually led me to help produce the film _Sound of Freedom_. **Not for fame.**
**Not for awards.**
**But because I believed people needed to see the truth.** For years, many people said the film would never succeed. Doors closed.
Studios walked away.
People told us to give up. **But when innocent children are suffering, silence is not an option.** And while the film helped awaken millions of people to this crisis, awareness alone is not enough. That is why we created the **Sound of Freedom Foundation**. Our mission is simple: **To stop the sale of God's children.**
---

---
Every day, vulnerable children are targeted by traffickers who prey on poverty, instability, loneliness, and fear. And every day, we work to fight back. This is a critical race to help flip the Senate

| | | [ ](https://act.elizabethwarren.com/go/216?t=3&akid=2941%2E4032634%2E0I48eL)

One of the most important races in the entire country is happening in ALASKA: **Mary Peltola is running for the U.S. Senate, and I’m proud to support her campaign.** Mary didn’t get into this race because it was easy. She saw that working people everywhere are facing skyrocketing grocery prices, unaffordable healthcare, and a rigged economy built for billionaires, and she decided to do something about it. So she got in the fight. And now, Republican super PACs are preparing to pour more than $15 million into defeating her. That kind of dark money isn’t just meant to influence elections — it’s meant to drown out the voices of ordinary people. We can’t let that happen. [**Will you split a donation of $28 — or whatever you can — to support Mary and our movement today? Every dollar moves us closer to flipping the Senate and passing policies that will make big, structural change for working people.**](https://act.elizabethwarren.com/go/3684?amount=28&t=8&akid=2941%2E4032634%2E0I48eL)

name: Andy Beshear
subject: Texas is in play
body:
The race for governor of Texas is one of the most important races in the country.
# [](https://ginafortexas.com/?refcode=em_ms_gh_header)[](https://ginafortexas.com/?refcode=em_ms_gh_header)
Hi Peter, it’s Andy Beshear.
Last month, I had a chance to speak with Gina about the stakes of her race.
[](https://act.ginafortexas.com/go/625?c0=em_ms_gh_20260625_2_andy.7lc5t0&refcode=em20260625-1420&amount=5&t=1&akid=1420%2E299639%2EgzI8ek)
Right now, I want to talk to you about why this **race for Governor of Texas is one of the most important races in the country.**
[**But first, will you donate $5 to Gina’s campaign for governor to win in Texas this November?**](https://act.ginafortexas.com/go/625?c0=em_ms_gh_20260625_2_andy.7lc5t0&refcode=em20260625-1420&amount=5&t=2&akid=1420%2E299639%2EgzI8ek)
Texas is growing fast, Peter, which means more congressional seats, more electoral votes, and more power over the direction of our country.
If Greg Abbott and Texas Republicans stay in control next year, they’ll keep trying to rig the maps, silence voters, and lock in power for themselves and their billionaire donors.
**Gina has already shown us she’ll fight back.**
She left the state _twice_ to block Abbott’s gerrymandered maps. She stood up to arrest threats. She refused to ask permission from Republican politicians to do the job her constituents elected her to do.
Now she’s running to become the governor who can veto rigged maps, protect public schools, lower costs, and finally put Texas families ahead of corrupt insiders.
I know what it’s like to compete in a red state. **I know these races are hard — but I also know they’re winnable when good people who are ready to make a difference step up.**
**[Will you donate $5 to Gina Hinojosa’s campaign today and help her win this important race?](https://act.ginafortexas.com/go/625?c0=em_ms_gh_20260625_2_andy.7lc5t0&refcode=em20260625-1420&amount=5&t=3&akid=1420%2E299639%2EgzI8ek)**

Thanks,
Andy Beshear
Governor of Kentucky

[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/134012156/629817338/846650056?refcode=em-6.25.26-all-a&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzMvMS85NjAyNCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI3ZTlkYTRkZi1jMzcwLWYxMTEtYWM5Yy0wMDBkM2E1NGJlZDAiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=Wdkc-OqJSvYReIA5YZgiu0iZ9ya8y_oth3Fana4JtCg=) Friend, I’ll get right to it. **Earlier this week, President Trump jumped into our race, endorsing one of my MAGA opponents. MI-08 remains one of the most competitive House races in the country. After carrying my district by 2 points, the President thinks he can use his name to win this seat. MAGA thinks this is one of their best chances to flip a blue seat red, so there’s a major target on our backs.** National Republicans know the path to the House majority runs through districts like ours. And that’s why it’s so important we have the resources to fight back. With just five days until our FEC fundraising deadline, I’m asking: will you chip in $3 to help us hit our goal? Here’s the link to donate: [**https://secure.actblue.com/donate/kmr-q2-2026**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/134012157/629817339/846650056?refcode=em-6.25.26-all-a&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzMvMS85NjAyNCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI3ZTlkYTRkZi1jMzcwLWYxMTEtYWM5Yy0wMDBkM2E1NGJlZDAiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=Wdkc-OqJSvYReIA5YZgiu0iZ9ya8y_oth3Fana4JtCg=) Last time around, politicos and DC consultants didn’t think we could win this race. They knew my opponent had enough dark money to seriously outspend us. But we proved them wrong. Hey folks,
This one turned into one of the most honest conversations we've had in a while. **David Hogg** joined me to unpack what the New York primaries actually mean, where Democrats are getting it right, where we're still getting it wrong, and why competition inside the party isn't something to fear--it's something we should embrace. We got into the hard questions. The messy ones. The debates a lot of people are afraid to have in public.
**Here 's what we got into:**
* [**00:01:07**] David breaks down the New York primary results, why voters are demanding something new, and what the victories say about the future of Democratic politics.
* [**00:07:16**] We debate whether challenging Democratic incumbents ultimately strengthens the party--and why internal competition might be exactly what's needed before November.
* [**00:14:16**] We tackle the controversy surrounding Daria Lisa, discuss political litmus tests, and wrestle with where Democrats should draw the line.
* [**00:20:00**] David explains why Leaders We Deserve is investing in young candidates at the state level and why experience still matters when building lasting political power.
* [**00:29:00**] We close with what Democrats need to offer voters beyond simply opposing Trump--and why hope, organizing, and anti-corruption have to become the party's defining message.

The fights happening inside the Democratic Party right now are shaping what comes next--not just in one city, but across the country. We talk about generational change, accountability, organizing, and what it really takes to earn voters' trust. Idaho sent four Republicans to Congress. Crapo. Risch. Fulcher. Simpson. And all four voted yes on H.R. 6644.
_Every single one._
This is a bill that lets HUD publish federal zoning guidelines telling your city council how to handle land use, _**doesn 't mention immigration once across 56 sections**_, and has banking deregulation provisions stapled to the back that couldn't pass on their own.
And all four Idaho Republicans said "sure, sounds great."
This thing passed the House 358-32 (41 not voting). Yikes. Because when has Washington agreeing on anything that hard ever worked out for you? For your neighborhood? Or for the town your grandpa built?
I think that nobody read this bill, I mean... look:
HUD publishes model guidelines encouraging duplexes, triplexes, and fourplexes in single-family neighborhoods. Then it ties some _Community Development Block Grant_ funding and competitive grants to demonstrated housing production and zoning reforms.
Manufactured homes are pushed into more subdivisions. Multifamily housing is incentivized in retail zones, and your quiet Idaho town with good schools gets a 200-unit apartment complex next to the elementary school.
And the bill's own stated purpose says it's about "increasing local flexibility over housing decisions." It publishes federal zoning frameworks while tying money to communities that don't build fast enough. That's the opposite of flexibility and every single person who voted yes either didn't read it or doesn't care... which one is worse? I don't know.
(Crapo, Risch, Fulcher, and Simpson apparently didn't ask)
The Founders actually built a mechanism to prevent exactly this. Many folks don't know that State legislatures used to pick senators. Before the 17th Amendment gutted that in 1913, Crapo and Risch would've had to walk into the Idaho statehouse and explain this vote. Face to face with state legislators who actually deal with zoning, who hear from county commissioners and city councils every week.
Try explaining to those people why you just handed their authority to HUD.
I bet they'd never have voted yes because the Idaho legislature would've yanked them.
_**But we don 't have that accountability anymore because senators answer to campaign donors and national party infrastructure now (not to their state governments, not to anyone who actually governs locally).**_
Two Idaho senators just voted for these federal zoning frameworks that the Idaho statehouse would probably reject if anyone bothered asking. The 17th Amendment didn't "democratize the Senate" and bills like H.R. 6644 are what that looks like when it plays out over a century later.
The immigration silence is where this bill tells on itself completely though. 56 sections and the word immigration appears _**exactly zero times.**_ We've got 50 million+ foreign-born people here. Net migration has been at historic levels in recent years, they're still flooding the labor market and housing market simultaneously and then acting baffled that Americans can't afford to live anywhere.
Idaho's seen some of the fastest population growth in the country and our entire delegation just voted for a bill that treats supply like it exists in a vacuum.
Demand doesn't matter apparently...
_**Where all these people are coming from doesn 't matter. Just build more units and don't ask questions. **_
This is a big green light to developers and foreigners and a big middle finger to our young people. Both parties know why they won't touch the demand side - the cheap-labor coalition funds both of them. Oh and they stapled a bunch of banking deregulation bills onto this thing too. All bills that couldn't pass on their own merits so they got smuggled inside an emotional vehicle about families who can't afford homes.
You want to deregulate community banks? Write a community banking bill. Go hold hearings on it. But nope, of course not... legislative laundering is easier (especially when parents are holding up pictures of their kids at the press conference).
The Opportunity Zones prioritization might actually be the worst part though. HUD gives additional weight to projects in "Opportunity Zones," which (if you forgot) was Senator Tim Scott's program that was supposed to lift distressed communities but mostly just became a way for connected investors to do luxury development in neighborhoods already gentrifying.
So now, if signed, we're stacking MORE federal incentives on top of a proven failure. Your local contractor in Nampa or Twin Falls building ten affordable houses? He's not getting those grants. Because he has no lobbyists, no federal grant writers, and really - no shot.
There's also an FHA small-dollar mortgage pilot. Sounds cool, right? Federal government backstopping mortgages for people who couldn't otherwise qualify. But oh wait, we tried this in 2008 and millions of families lost everything. But slap a "pilot program" label on it so it sounds cautious and here we go running it back like the 08' crash never happened (I believe the kids call this "retard-maxing").
Only five Republican senators voted no.
_**Not Crapo.**_
_**Not Risch.**_
_**Not Fulcher.**_
_**Not Simpson.**_
Kudos to Mike Lee though who got closest to actually saying the real thing when he argued the bill _**" does not do nearly enough to safeguard housing programs for American citizens only"**_ and called for mass deportations as the actual housing fix.
But Idaho's congressmen couldn't be bothered to make that argument. Or any argument apparently.
The Senate vote was 85-5 (with 10 not voting). Both parties' donor bases got fed and they wrapped it in compassion language so you'd feel weird opposing it.
Pat Buchanan warned about this his entire career (i.e. when both parties are clapping, check your wallet). Connected developers are eating off federal grants, banks got their deregulation smuggled through without a standalone vote, and HUD's budget just got fatter.
Oh, and, your kid who can't afford a starter home in Meridian? He gets a pilot program, a study, a framework, and a report.
Sincerely, your entire Idaho delegation.

| Earlier this week, I told you what our team was bracing for.
After my friends and fellow anti-corporate PAC, anti-AIPAC progressive candidates beat the establishment in New York on Tuesday night, we knew the dark-money machine would panic.
They can't afford to lose another reliable vote in Congress, another blank check, or another politician who does the bidding of billionaires, corporate lobbyists, and AIPAC instead of working people.
We knew they'd come for us next, and now they're here:
A dark-money Super PAC, formed just last month with hidden funders, announced today that it's dropping another $1,000,000 into this race in order to stop us.
What we do know is last month, this brand new Super PAC received nearly $1 million from a reported AIPAC shell PAC.
---
| [DONATE - FIGHT BACK](https://cefuo8hbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001WAhCXT1ZfwFZXFIAk30wfAdia0MUptjHD6JJvEPRpwKMEujIWXxqOh7CJsIS5y884vPZy49leHV2tSH8qBy22S14jMrKW2KJ6AArfSTYdvQLgD1Xsybw9oOTcTJ-4bR3x0VJ4GetmMB3AwAlKtAuluoYoBKl_S1snJ6o5yJ0cPdd3q56qDL7L5R-_4xM3reqE3ZRO2c1p4XaypJlktEq7CgeXaGQF4InebC7Mdc3BsfJa5nnNWoZxKu-5BRInXuQpMBWyrG-NHAnhXntaIq9-hJXkbEsbYW5TTR5pVl_7nc=&c=EV4pev3WanDCQr92rArS864RlPQ739vnVM4--s2uPB-daKufk33k1A==&ch=pLV0gozcUxyrBG1KkTT4IxixgYxlI1CMNP3lbCzeVU6i7turEFC6ww==)

| We know AIPAC's playbook.
They will launch ads to pretend this is about "progressive issues" while spending obscene amounts of money to protect an incumbent who has spent decades taking corporate PAC checks, voting for bottomless bombs & weapons, and refusing to support the kind of moral clarity this moment demands.
They will try to prop up Diana DeGette while continuing the same racist and xenophobic attacks that have already been used against me. Attacks that she's been calling for Super PACs to use on her own website.
And they will hide most of their donors from Denver voters until after the final ballot is cast because they know the truth is ugly.
AIPAC and the corporate establishment backing DeGette do not care about housing costs in Denver, Medicare for All, universal child care, wages, rent, or whether working people can survive in this city.
They care about keeping people in Congress who will keep writing blank checks to the Israeli government while it carries out a genocide in Gaza with U.S.-funded weapons. This week, a new UN report from an independent commission found that Israel has been and continues to deliberately target children.
And elected leaders, like Diana DeGette, are voting to enable all of it.
Groups like AIPAC spend millions because they know Congress is where those weapons packages get approved and where blank checks are signed. They know Congress is where politicians either fall in line or have the courage to say no.
Diana DeGette will not say no.
I will.
When I get to Congress, I will immediately sign onto the Block the Bombs Act, fight for an arms embargo, and refuse to let our tax dollars be used to fund genocide.
And this is why we believe they're spending more than $1,000,000 to stop us.
[I am asking you directly: Can you donate to help us fight back against this dark money dump and win this race?](https://cefuo8hbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001WAhCXT1ZfwFZXFIAk30wfAdia0MUptjHD6JJvEPRpwKMEujIWXxqOh7CJsIS5y884vPZy49leHV2tSH8qBy22S14jMrKW2KJ6AArfSTYdvQLgD1Xsybw9oOTcTJ-4bR3x0VJ4GetmMB3AwAlKtAuluoYoBKl_S1snJ6o5yJ0cPdd3q56qDL7L5R-_4xM3reqE3ZRO2c1p4XaypJlktEq7CgeXaGQF4In-7mX2RiiDTr1ihxnVEYtxw==&c=EV4pev3WanDCQr92rArS864RlPQ739vnVM4--s2uPB-daKufk33k1A==&ch=pLV0gozcUxyrBG1KkTT4IxixgYxlI1CMNP3lbCzeVU6i7turEFC6ww==)
We are a city that is ready for a representative who answers to Denver, not AIPAC, Big Pharma, corporate lobbyists, ICE contractors, Big Oil, or an establishment that failed so terribly at their job that Donald Trump got a second term.
Together, we'll fight back.
- Melat

subject: my north star
disclaimer_text: Paid for by McBride for Delaware
body:
# [](https://act.sarahmcbride.com/go/1269?t=1&akid=3461%2E21716%2EACHaix)
This might be a strange thing to read, but I hope you’ll allow me to explain:
**When my husband Andy was battling cancer, we knew we were lucky.**
We knew how lucky he was to have health insurance that would allow him to get the care that would hopefully save his life.
We understood how lucky we were to have the flexibility with our jobs that allowed him to focus on the full-time job of getting care and me to focus on the full-time job of being his caregiver — of supporting him through chemotherapy, radiation, surgery, and of loving him. And when we found out his cancer was terminal, to be there by his side to marry him and to walk him to his passing.
[](https://act.sarahmcbride.com/go/1184?c0=mcb-em-20260625-1.qJUDtt&refcode=em20260625-3461&t=2&akid=3461%2E21716%2EACHaix)
I decided to run for office because up until his last breath, Andy knew he was lucky — and in the wealthiest nation on earth, the time and ability to get care should not be a matter of luck.
That’s why universal paid family and medical leave is my North Star. It’s why I’m working around the clock to build the support we need in Congress to finally make it law of the land — and I need your support to keep up the fight.
[**If you believe, as I do, that getting care should never be a matter of luck, will you chip in $5 to power my work today?** ](https://act.sarahmcbride.com/go/1184?c0=mcb-em-20260625-1.qJUDtt&refcode=em20260625-3461&amount=5&t=3&akid=3461%2E21716%2EACHaix)
**[Donate $5 »](https://act.sarahmcbride.com/go/1184?c0=mcb-em-20260625-1.qJUDtt&amount=5&refcode=em20260625-3461&t=22&akid=3461%2E21716%2EACHaix)**
Grassroots support gives me the ability to keep the broad coalition we need to ensure every family — whether they are welcoming a child or facing the abject terror of a serious illness — has the same security Andy and I were fortunate enough to have.
Thank you,
Sarah McBride

| | **June was a busy month in Congress.** This month, I helped advance bipartisan legislation to reauthorize the Northwest Straits Commission. The Commission's bottom-up approach has ensured that local communities have the resources and expertise they need to keep marine habitats healthy and recover endangered and threatened species, including Southern Resident Killer Whales and salmon. [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/134016002/629824056/659761720?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTMvMS84NzY1OSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIxNzdmYjUwZi1jODcwLWYxMTEtYWM5Yy0wMDBkM2E1NGJlZDAiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=RhDrovd9JOXj9H6-UjVLSqt5PwHuaLypUo5Ub0nNxDQ=&emci=266b51d0-166f-f111-ac9c-000d3a54bed0&emdi=177fb50f-c870-f111-ac9c-000d3a54bed0&ceid=9494239) [READ MORE](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/134016004/629824058/659761720?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTMvMS84NzY1OSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIxNzdmYjUwZi1jODcwLWYxMTEtYWM5Yy0wMDBkM2E1NGJlZDAiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=RhDrovd9JOXj9H6-UjVLSqt5PwHuaLypUo5Ub0nNxDQ=&emci=266b51d0-166f-f111-ac9c-000d3a54bed0&emdi=177fb50f-c870-f111-ac9c-000d3a54bed0&ceid=9494239) This bill provides the necessary funding for the Commission to continue its work to restore the marine ecosystem of the Northwest Straits region and support local jobs. The Northwest Straits region contributes 16,000 jobs to Washington's commercial and recreational fishing industries and $150 million in economic output for the state's aquaculture industry. Finally, I voted against legislation that would provide billions of dollars to immigration enforcement. I will continue to oppose funding ICE until the agency is required to follow the same rules as every other local, state, and federal law enforcement agency. clean_body: June was a busy month both in Congress and here at home in Northwest Washington. | | | | June was a busy month in Congress. This month, I helped advance bipartisan legislation to reauthorize the Northwest Straits Commission. The Commission's bottom-up approach has ensured that local communities have the resources and expertise they need to keep marine habitats healthy and recover endangered and threatened species, including Southern Resident Killer Whales and salmon. This bill provides the necessary funding for the Commission to continue its work to restore the marine ecosystem of the Northwest Straits region and support local jobs. The Northwest Straits region contributes 16,000 jobs to Washington's commercial and recreational fishing industries and $150 million in economic output for the state's aquaculture industry. Finally, I voted against legislation that would provide billions of dollars to immigration enforcement. I will continue to oppose funding ICE until the agency is required to follow the same rules as every other local, state, and federal law enforcement agency. I proposed amendments to instead spend these dollars helping families recover from natural disasters, growing the local economy, supporting veterans and their families, helping local law enforcement fight drug trafficking, and educating students with disabilities. # [Today, absentee ballots go out](https://substack.com/app-link/post?publication_id=6380051&post_id=203456082&utm_source=post-email-title&utm_campaign=email-post-title&isFreemail=true&r=1hvr60&token=eyJ1c2VyX2lkIjo5MDUwMTE5MiwicG9zdF9pZCI6MjAzNDU2MDgyLCJpYXQiOjE3ODI0MTQzMjcsImV4cCI6MTc4NTAwNjMyNywiaXNzIjoicHViLTYzODAwNTEiLCJzdWIiOiJwb3N0LXJlYWN0aW9uIn0.o7-xrwLNiCRBL6Fudst4C88k7shQXyEUh5ArGXZiPpA)
### Election Day is 40 days away
| | [Haley Stevens](https://substack.com/@haleyformi)
---
| Jun 25
---
| [](https://substack.com/@haleyformi)
---

---
| | | [](https://substack..PkR-EnN84o4OR3MsT87utR1x7WdQ2HnHnALCjx4y82k?&utm_source=substack&utm_medium=email)
---
| | [READ IN APP](https://open.substack.com/pub/haleyformi/p/today-absentee-ballots-go-out?utm_source=email&redirect=app-store&utm_campaign=email-read-in-app)
---

Today has been circled on my calendar for a long time.
**June 25 is a big day because absentee ballots are officially going out across Michigan.** That means Aug. 4 is no longer some far-off date on the calendar - Election Day is just 40 days away. It's real, friends.
And I have to say, I'm excited.
This grassroots team has been working toward this moment, and I'm more fired up than ever to bust my tail these next 40 days to earn the votes of Michiganders.
So let me ask you something. If you're in Michigan, have you made a plan to vote?
Maybe you know you'll be out of town on Aug. 4. Or maybe you work long hours, you're caring for a parent or a kid, or you have a packed summer schedule. Whatever your reason, voting absentee is actually super easy. You can request your ballot here: **[ABSENTEE VOTING IN MICHIGAN.](https://substack.com/redirect/2898ba6a-cc19-4a3e-80ac-28926bf425d5?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**
I truly appreciate every person who supports this campaign, but I have to tell you, nothing makes me happier than seeing grassroots supporters make a plan to vote. I love it.
I know, I'm a nerd. But there's nothing that makes me prouder to be an American than democracy in action.
The calendar is moving fast. In 40 days, Michiganders will choose which Democrat takes on Mike Rogers and the MAGA machine in November.
You probably know the polls have been encouraging - they show I'm the strongest Democrat in this race and in the best position to defeat Mike Rogers. But polls don't vote. What really matters is whether people like you make a plan, cast a ballot, and make your voice heard.
The people we send to Washington will make decisions about gas prices, health insurance, Social Security, prescription drug costs, good jobs, and whether the government makes life easier or harder for regular people. Those aren't abstract issues. They're real problems for hardworking Michiganders, and they deserve public servants who understand them and can deliver results.
Michigan could determine control of the U.S. Senate. We have a real chance to put a check on the MAGA agenda, but only if people show up and vote.
So please, make a voting plan. Request your absentee ballot if you need one. Talk to your friends and family. Put Aug. 4 on the calendar. Heck, circle it in red like I do!
Because that is the day we take the next important step toward keeping Michigan blue.
And, if you are able, I hope you will chip in a few dollars to help our campaign reach voters across Michigan in these final weeks before the primary. Every contribution helps us make more calls, knock more doors, and make sure folks know how, when, and where to vote.
[CHIP IN TO SUPPORT VOTER OUTREACH](https://substack.com/redirect/26f377a3-7013-4985-bb46-e2e51a50234c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
More soon.
With grit,
Haley

A personal note from Haley 👋

I'm a lifelong Michigander and the daughter of small-business owners. I've spent my career fighting for Michigan's working families - and now I'm running for the U.S. Senate to keep standing up for the people I love.

But here's the truth: Senate control could come down to Michigan. And Trump and his megadonors know it. That's why they're gearing up to spend tens of millions to defeat me and hand this seat to a MAGA Republican.

I need your help to fight back. This race will be one of the most competitive - and expensive - in the country, and I'm counting on grassroots support to win.

If you're with me, will you chip in today?
[Donate](https://substack.com/redirect/26f377a3-7013-4985-bb46-e2e51a50234c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)

This is a ground game. This is person-to-person, human-to-human, mukluk telegraph.

body:
New poll has Democratic incumbent Anita Earls with a five-point advantage over Republican challenger Sarah Stevens, 40% to 35%. Over 20% are undecided. The stakes could not be higher.
| | | | | [](https://yfq78zhbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=0014fmiKcobZmmEimP2ImLmh_YUDacvode4jMZM3v-PwHIHe8NX38L5hKocrzfRBVyleXeLOQmMRPZbMYEcA8-n5P_Rp-q2xm_L5yEDtOUJZNFFd2vv7K4bBSELyecbJq-GLPF4QvQZr-1akj79m3weOp_WAGf44_83X6nMtAqdivKok-oVHN9snfnvCSLzTqgG6XlDZRnrzeP3Mcsl4BwuPO_0kIHsCjHkt67UHKRP2YA=&c=xZF-1FZeddn6PIsXIc3P6n8rUmnLrhU8I2x1hRHb4msnD_ENv5pNvg==&ch=H4o-QD97MIFtsxvS-W45tESZbH0UzYjz1VHhUm-4NgYP1tSuXZGu-A==)
---
|
Peter,
In late 2024 after the dust had settled from the presidential election, a vicious battle was unfolding in the key swing state of North Carolina that threatened to set a terrible precedent that Trump could exploit for his next Big Lie.
The stakes were for a seemingly boring but actually life or death contested state Supreme Court seat that Democrat Allison Riggs had won by 734 votes. But the case held wider consequences for elections everywhere.
The Republican candidate, Jefferson Griffin, launched an expensive 6 month legal Hail Mary to try and have over 60,000 votes cast by North Carolina citizens thrown out. And he nearly succeeded.
If Griffin had prevailed in court, it would have upended a basic principle of election law and democratic fairness: you can't change the rules of an election after the election has taken place.
In the end, the NC Supreme Court with its 5-2 Republican majority seemed inclined to side with Griffin on some of his arguments -- but a federal court decisively blocked it. Griffin conceded shortly after.
---
| [](https://yfq78zhbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=0014fmiKcobZmmEimP2ImLmh_YUDacvode4jMZM3v-PwHIHe8NX38L5hKocrzfRBVyleXeLOQmMRPZbMYEcA8-n5P_Rp-q2xm_L5yEDtOUJZNFFd2vv7K4bBSELyecbJq-GLPF4QvQZr-1akj79m3weOp_WAGf44_83X6nMtAqdivKok-oVHN9snfnvCSLzTqgG6XlDZRnrzeP3Mcsl4BwuPHjGyekbQRViX3SALxqIZyI=&c=xZF-1FZeddn6PIsXIc3P6n8rUmnLrhU8I2x1hRHb4msnD_ENv5pNvg==&ch=H4o-QD97MIFtsxvS-W45tESZbH0UzYjz1VHhUm-4NgYP1tSuXZGu-A==)
---
We can't always rely on federal courts to do the right thing. Especially not now, as Trump's unqualified crony judicial nominees are confirmed to the bench at breakneck speed by the Republican Senate.
These judicial elections may seem boring but building the state supreme court firewall in key states like North Carolina is of critical national importance.

I am so excited to announce _some_ of the worship leaders joining us for Let Us Worship at Nashville's historic Ryman Auditorium next month — Britt Nicole, Rebekah White, Mitch Wong, Laura Hackett Park, and Jonas Park. And more are on the way! The Ryman has hosted some of the most famous acts in the world, but this time, it's hosting the power of the Holy Spirit! And this isn't the first time Let Us Worship has been to Nashville. Five years ago, God moved powerfully in the city, and we are expectant for Him to move again!
---
---

Barack Obama recently opened his **[45,000](https://substack.com/redirect/dff51a63-87e0-4fa2-ba46-f39da5f707ee?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** square foot community center more than a decade after leaving the White House. Initial estimates in 2016 believed the Obama library would cost around $300 million. By 2021, the estimated cost had soared to $830 million. The timeline for the project kept extending. When the Jackson Park location was first selected in 2015, an opening date of 2021 was set. Due to a series of legal battles, the construction process was delayed, finally opening this summer.
But extended timelines and costs are just the tip of the iceberg for why the project should raise serious concerns.
The Obama Foundation intentionally set Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion goals in the construction of the Presidential Center. They **[asked](https://substack.com/redirect/a33a0518-6ab7-41b4-9eee-38dc56facf5b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** construction managers to hire minority groups including women and LGBT run businesses for at least 50% of its subcontractors. It set a strict requirement forcing 35% of all subcontractors to be minority owned. Further, they required subcontractors to prove that they had a "history of working with diverse suppliers", prove that they had made charitable donations to "environmental and civil rights causes," and were implementing DEI practices on their boards. Their stated goal was to engage "minority populations in the construction process," but their DEI intentions ultimately backfired.

_**Piece continues**_
In January 2025, one minority owned subcontractor filed a **[$40 million](https://substack.com/redirect/78189fc3-c331-4241-9bb6-a1b3270429a3?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** lawsuit against an engineering and design company that oversaw work on the Center. The subcontractor had provided concrete for the new build, but claimed they were unfairly subjected to excessive inspections and requirements which caused them to incur debt. Although the Obama Foundation tried to stay out of it, the lawsuit repeatedly linked the engineering company to the Foundation, stating that they couldn't believe the "Obama Foundation's structural engineer would single out a minority-owned subcontractor for unfair criticism... while, in the same letter, stating that the non-minority-owned contractors were sufficiently qualified."
The foundation had a harder time distancing themselves from additional accusations that they haven't reimbursed several of their subcontractors. Michael Owen, the president of Adamson Plumbing Contractors, claims that the Obama Foundation still owes him **[$4 million.](https://substack.com/redirect/fe54a61d-fea8-463d-8577-35a83deb9982?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** Worse, that discrepancy may force his company into bankruptcy. He originally had a $6.9 million bid for the project but "disorganization", "design changes", and several subcontractors falling behind schedule led to additional work.
The Obama Foundation **[claimed](https://substack.com/redirect/165e7248-efc2-40dc-b8e6-102024a2df32?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** it had "accelerated a number of payment timelines, and in some cases, advanced payment several months before the work was completed" and that they were "committed to a subcontracting process that exceeds industry standards for financial support." This advanced payment structure may explain why some of the work was delayed by subcontractors, extending the construction process.
Owen's company paid for much of the project out of their own pocket, so as not to undermine the foundation's efforts to promote minority-owned businesses or sabotage a high-status project. Owen also feared that speaking out might prevent his company from being compensated and could turn potential clients in an **[overwhelmingly](https://substack.com/redirect/805d1e84-6d73-40f8-983f-a42a4c808029?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** Democrat city away.

* * *
* * *
Owen's business wasn't the only one affected by the disorganized construction process. Multiple other businesses have also claimed millions in losses, but refuse to speak openly about their financial concerns for fear of backlash. Other companies claim that they are inhibited by non-disclosure agreements, which have also prevented business owners from providing evidence corroborating claimed losses. Neither the Obama Foundation nor the Lakeside Alliance, a joint venture of five firms managing construction over the Center, have "directly disputed allegations from some subcontractors that they incurred losses while working on the project."
The Presidential Center has faced allegations of robbing citizens since 2018, when a controversial 99 year agreement allowed for the Center to be built on the site of a former public works project. It now sits on public land that was handed over to the private Obama Foundation for just $10. As Illinois GOP Chairman Grogan said, "[The Foundation] had to go all the way through the court system, because they were violating the public trust doctrine." This, too, led to delays in the Center's opening. But Grogan has one other concern: "Some fear it's going to be a Maoist indoctrination center over time because it's NOT a Presidential center."

Friend...

Could a simple ritual before bed be the answer to burning, swelling, and tingling feet — including those pins and needles on the bottoms of your feet?

The National Library of Medicine says, “YES!”

Your feet have a natural recovery cycle that's supposed to kick in every night — calming irritated nerves and easing the swelling.

But after 50, that nightly recovery cycle slows down. So instead of waking up to calmer feet, you wake up to the same burning and tingling… or worse.

Here's the good news: you can give that nightly “foot reset” a jump-start — right from your recliner.

Reset your feet tonight: –>

The simple at-home ritual that calms burning, swelling, and tingling feet

This is getting a lot of attention right now…

Because for years, people were told the only options were creams, compression socks, or pills that mask the pain temporarily…

So eventually the burning, tingling, and discomfort comes right back.

The good news is you can reset your feet tonight.

I think this is the closest thing yet to an answer for tired, aching feet:
