name: Aruna Miller
subject: The ticket is set.
body:
Peter, it’s Lieutenant Governor Aruna Miller.
**This week, Wes and I won our Democratic primary election!** I’m incredibly grateful for the trust that Maryland voters continue to place in Wes and me.
This victory means that we are officially in the general election. We’re entering the final sprint of our race for re-election, so I’m personally asking supporters like you to add your support to our campaign for the very first time today.
**We’ve set a goal to raise $100,000 in these first 48 hours of the general election, so I’m counting on your urgent support, Peter.**[**Can you pitch in $5 or whatever your budget allows for today, to power our campaign as we enter the general election? Thank you in advance for your support.**](https://act.wesmoore.com/go/417?c0=wes-em-20260625-1.lYXFdt&refcode=em-20260625-1&t=1&akid=1545%2E1086043%2E3pzKiF)
Serving as Lieutenant Governor of Maryland is an honor that I’ll never take for granted, Peter.
I came to this country as a little girl — an immigrant who believed in the American dream. The opportunity to serve as Maryland’s first woman of color and immigrant elected official as Lieutenant Governor is a reminder of all that’s possible here in our great state of Maryland.
Serving in this administration has been the honor of my lifetime, and I’m so proud of the progress we’ve won together for working people.
**But our work is not finished.** That’s why Wes and I ultimately decided to run for re-election. And it’s why Wes and I are relying on folks like you as we begin this next crucial phase of the race.
If you’re a strong supporter of our campaign, today is an important day to show it. [**We’re still short of our 48-hour goal to raise $100,000 to power us to victory in the general election, so any amount you can chip in would be so appreciated.**](https://act.wesmoore.com/go/417?c0=wes-em-20260625-1.lYXFdt&refcode=em-20260625-1&t=2&akid=1545%2E1086043%2E3pzKiF)
Thank you for your trust in us,
Aruna Miller
Lieutenant Governor, Maryland

When I came home to Southwestern Pennsylvania | [](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.iIBo0N5fSFzEFL40Tn-vtbMETCUYClkOrOh9-SNJfqtGRMv0nzZSqpumbiKur0eaS3lZvSFtd5BcFQVPL9D4ENRiV89v3QZmdg64PnqAz0z7Yj1d12pAtAG66iTzZeOp6cm_qrjEBlF_XVeNkLeYSZ4AN9nwIqJ7Eq3N5EH0nu0y07F791fRwLiYv7kUchWNpWxpeVMhyZQs1V-Fu9wBognO4R-eamGc3bwhldXic6XDxRuZIv9CIhYqsEw3pQ-IjNtm8HPeE5-BNCLCKy9gyB3Q8M_kruor0SPA6Wk4q-7_WicE09oNFeIi0r93OR73iSpq_ugxJFPdt5fZ5kexYaMKIW1iq3_pfcGnFtP6F0jixcvZvFaYnZeFduz0upjN/4rs/v7z3FPhhReW57eJtXj0wdg/h0/h001.c6ptTCPdlllPMnOq7hMUyXFuYiLMJe-_Xj9qqL9WGHs) Friends, When I left Southwestern Pennsylvania as a young Army officer, I never imagined I would one day run for Congress. I certainly never imagined that I would spend nearly three decades serving our country — first in the Army and later as an FBI Special Agent. Throughout my career, the mission was always bigger than me. **My job was to serve, solve problems, and do what was right, even when it wasn't easy.** After retiring from the FBI, I came home. As I traveled across Southwestern Pennsylvania, I met hardworking families doing everything right but struggling to keep up with rising costs. I met seniors worried about the future of Social Security and Medicare. I met young people who want to build their lives here but wonder whether the opportunities will be there. **I also heard a common frustration: too many politicians seem focused on politics, while everyday people are left waiting for results.** That's why I'm running for Congress. Not because I want a political career. I've already had a career serving this country. I'm running because I believe public service still matters, and because I believe Southwestern Pennsylvania deserves a representative who will listen, show up, and fight for the people who live here. I support protecting Social Security and Medicare, lowering costs for working families, creating good-paying jobs, strengthening healthcare access, and bringing accountability back to Washington. I also believe it's time for term limits and a ban on members of Congress trading individual stocks while in office. The people deserve to know their elected officials are working for them—not for personal gain. **This campaign isn't funded by corporate PACs or special interests. It's powered by people who believe our government should work for the people it serves.** [If you're one of those people, I'm asking for your support today. clean_body: When I came home to Southwestern Pennsylvania | Friends, When I left Southwestern Pennsylvania as a young Army officer, I never imagined I would one day run for Congress. I certainly never imagined that I would spend nearly three decades serving our country — first in the Army and later as an FBI Special Agent. Throughout my career, the mission was always bigger than me. My job was to serve, solve problems, and do what was right, even when it wasn't easy. After retiring from the FBI, I came home. As I traveled across Southwestern Pennsylvania, I met hardworking families doing everything right but struggling to keep up with rising costs. I met seniors worried about the future of Social Security and Medicare. I met young people who want to build their lives here but wonder whether the opportunities will be there. I also heard a common frustration: too many politicians seem focused on politics, while everyday people are left waiting for results. That's why I'm running for Congress. Not because I want a political career. I've already had a career serving this country. I'm running because I believe public service still matters, and because I believe Southwestern Pennsylvania deserves a representative who will listen, show up, and fight for the people who live here. I support protecting Social Security and Medicare, lowering costs for working families, creating good-paying jobs, strengthening healthcare access, and bringing accountability back to Washington. I also believe it's time for term limits and a ban on members of Congress trading individual stocks while in office. The people deserve to know their elected officials are working for them—not for personal gain. This campaign isn't funded by corporate PACs or special interests. It's powered by people who believe our government should work for the people it serves. Thank you for your support, and thank you for believing that public service still matters. Sincerely, Alan Bradstock Candidate for Congress Army Veteran | Retired FBI Agent If you've saved your payment info with ActBlue Express, your donation will process immediately. MAGA loyalist Guy Reschenthaler has consistently put party loyalty and corporate interests ahead of working families in our district. It’s time for real leadership that puts people first. Democrat Alan Bradstock is stepping up to fight for affordable healthcare, reproductive freedom, workers’ rights, and a stronger democracy, but he can’t do it without your support. 🚨 Everything from gas to groceries is getting unaffordable.

✅ We added hundreds of thousands of good-paying jobs.

name: Voto Latino
subject: The Trump administration's message is straight-up dehumanizing
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Voto Latino
body:
Immigrants are the foundation of this country.
#
Peter, throughout all of June, we celebrate National Immigrant Heritage Month.
This month celebrates the generations of immigrants who helped build this country.
But this year, the Trump administration chose a different message.
Instead of recognizing those contributions that immigrants have brought to this country since its founding, the administration launched a government webpage titled “Aliens,” using language like _“They walk among us”_ and _“They do not belong here.”_
_[](https://act.votolatino.org/go/305?c0=em-ms-voto-20260625-1.ZcOyWl&refcode=em20260625-302&t=1&akid=302%2E1366028%2ERoDBeU)
[](https://act.votolatino.org/go/305?c0=em-ms-voto-20260625-1.ZcOyWl&refcode=em20260625-302&t=2&akid=302%2E1366028%2ERoDBeU)_
They’re talking about immigrants, Peter.
It’s not just cruel; it’s straight-up dehumanizing. And during a month that’s meant to honor immigrant communities, it tells us exactly how this administration defines the belonging of people who aren’t originally from this country.
Immigrants aren’t hiding among us. It’s who we all are. They are nurses, teachers, business owners, veterans, parents, neighbors, and friends. They’re the very foundation of this country.
Voto Latino is organizing to make sure all communities are registered, informed, and ready to make our voices heard so that we can fight back against Trump and his backwards agenda — because it doesn’t serve anyone but him and his base.

Thank you,
Voto Latino

And now, years later, the vengeful Democrats are cashing in on what they see as their LAST SHOT to JAIL an INNOCENT 82-year-old man for the rest of his years! Make no mistake, the Left’s playbook is always to wear you down... That is why on the eve of 250 years of American independence, you will not see me sulk in the possibility of spending the rest of my life behind bars as an innocent man. Instead, I will continue to use the freedoms this beautiful country provides us to FIGHT for true justice. I will NEVER SURRENDER! As the saying goes, I would rather die on my feet than live on my knees. And the battlefield of my fight is in the courtroom, Peter. Asking for help has never been my strong suit, so believe me when I say that I’m reaching out today because YOU are my last hope of keeping my defense going. The Democrats have already STRIPPED me of my law licenses, pushed me to the point of BANKRUPTCY, and will not stop until they see me finished. They know full well that the kind of legal defense it will take to beat these phony charges has to be the best of the best... and they also know that it won’t come cheap. Why else do you think they worked so hard to force me to the brink of bankruptcy? If you can’t afford to help right now, please just hit the back button on this letter and carry on with your day. Take care of your family and yourself first. Your thoughts and prayers already mean the world to me. But if you can contribute to my new Defense Trust, just know that I could use your support now more than ever to retain a top-notch defense team. subject: The Mountain Minute: 6/25/2026 + TOMORROW IS FREEDOM FEST!
body:
Colorado non-citizen households used welfare at a far higher rate than the U.S.-born.
| | | | [](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
---
**PRESENTED BY[ROCKYMOUNTAINVOICE.COM](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
| | Hi friends!
Want your full news breakdown? Listen to the Mountain Minute podcast [here](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.), or watch on [YouTube](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) or [Rumble](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.).
**🇺🇸 Rocky Mountain Voice Freedom Festival Starts TOMORROW!**
The wait is almost over.
Tomorrow, thousands of Coloradans will gather in Castle Rock for Rocky Mountain Voice Freedom Festival—a two-day celebration of America's 250th Birthday and Colorado's 150th Birthday featuring incredible speakers, live entertainment, family activities, and an unforgettable weekend of patriotism.
🎟️**Already have tickets?** Be sure to check your email! We sent attendee information, maps, parking details, and everything you'll need to know before you arrive.
📱 **Can't make it?** Follow Rocky Mountain Voice on Facebook, Instagram, X, and YouTube for live updates, photos, interviews, and highlights throughout the weekend.
🤠 There's still time to join us! Rodeo tickets are still available and are the perfect way to experience Freedom Festival on Saturday. At just $45, you'll enjoy rodeo action, live music from Curtis Grimes, the Family Fest, and FREE admission for kids 17 and under with a ticketed adult.
🎟️ **[RMVFreedomFest.com](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
We can't wait to celebrate with you. See you tomorrow in Castle Rock! 🇺🇸
This is your Mountain Minute for Thursday, June 25, 2026.
– Team RMV
---
[LAST CHANCE FOR TICKETS](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
|
---
**TODAY'S TOP STORIES**
**[Colorado non-citizen households used welfare at a far higher rate than the U.S.-born.](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** BY SHAINA COLE, [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
[](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
Half of Colorado households headed by a non-citizen, regardless of legal status, either used a traditional welfare program or qualified for federal tax credits aimed at low-wage workers. That is the finding of a new national report the Center for Immigration Studies released June 11. It is built on five years of Census Bureau survey data, pooled to get state samples large enough to be meaningful.
The numbers come at a moment when Colorado is still absorbing the fiscal fallout from its own immigrant health coverage program, one that was projected to cost $27 million and enrolled more than eight times as many people as the legislature anticipated. And they arrive just weeks after Colorado began implementing federal food-stamp restrictions that ended SNAP eligibility for many non-citizens.
The data offers the clearest picture yet of what non-citizen households in Colorado were accessing — and what is now being cut.
**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
[](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
**Be part of history at Freedom Festival 2026.** Celebrate America’s 250th and Colorado’s 150th with with 2000+ patriots: two unforgettable days of speakers, action, community, and FUN for the whole family at the Douglas County Fairgrounds. _America only turns 250 once. Colorado only turns 150 once._ Secure your tickets now and be part of it.
[GET YOUR TICKETS NOW!](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
|
---
**[Colorado Medicaid Freezes Payments to Home Health Agency Facing Fraud Investigation](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [COLORADO POLITICS](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* Colorado's Medicaid oversight agency has halted payments to On Going Home Health Care, an Aurora-based agency accused of billing for services never rendered — with reimbursements skyrocketing from just over $1 million in 2022 to more than $20 million in 2025, a red flag that state investigators say reflects "credible" fraud.
* "The Program" exploited vulnerable homeless individuals by offering free housing and cash payments as inducements to allow the agency to bill their Medicaid accounts — a clear violation of federal law prohibiting payments used to steer Medicaid beneficiaries toward specific providers.
* The FBI is also now investigating, underscoring how lax Medicaid oversight enabled a network of interconnected businesses — including a shell church and a housing company run by friends and family — to drain tens of millions in taxpayer dollars before journalists at The Denver Gazette exposed the scheme.

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
The Rocky Mountain Voice is a 501(c)(3) that exists to promote informed civic engagement and the principles of self-governance through enterprise reporting on public policy, politics, government, and culture throughout the state of Colorado. The only way we can continue to spread truth is with your support!
[DONATE TO ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
|
---
**ONLY ON ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE ⤵️**
**[Mike Davis changed the Supreme Court. Now he has Colorado officials in his sights.](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
**[](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)****BY SHAINA COLE | STATE | JUNE 23** _On the morning Tina Peters walked out of a Colorado prison, Mike Davis was already filing paperwork. The referral went to the Department of Justice before the cameras left. It named four Colorado officials — Mesa County District Judge Matthew Barrett, Attorney General Phil Weiser, Mesa County District Attorney Dan Rubinstein, and Secretary of State Jena Griswold — and called on Assistant Attorney General for Civil Rights Harmeet Dhillon to open a federal criminal investigation into the prosecution that put Peters away._ __
**[She circled his photo in seventh grade. For America’s 250th, she’s taking his name to Washington](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
**[](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)****BY JEN SCHUMANN | STATE | JUNE 23** _Days before leaving on a trip she has waited 50 years to take, Rahna Autrey walked into her garage and found a face she had promised never to forget. The tub of childhood keepsakes sat on a shelf in her garage. Inside was her seventh-grade scrapbook, Partridge Family magazines and all. Inside was the brochure that came with her bracelet. One photograph had a blue circle drawn around it._ __
**[Colorado’s main suer runs on Trump](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
**[](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)****BY TOM ANTHONY | COMMENTARY | JUNE 22** _According to Tucker Carlson interviewee Joe Kent, erstwhile Director of Counterterrorism, it was Netanyahu that induced the US to attack Iran. Of course Trump is taking the blame and that goes with being President, as executive decisions have their consequences. High gas prices aren’t popular with too many people (we’re excepting the ones who own oil wells) and so being anti-Trump has gotten somewhat easier on both sides of the aisle._
__

**Feel like you have a unique story, commentary or tip to share?** Email [submit@rockymountainvoice.com](mailto:submit@rockymountainvoice.com).
|

|
---
🧐**DID YOU KNOW?** Former Colorado Governor John Long Routt—the state's very first governor—originally had to deal with the bizarre legacy of his territorial predecessor, Edward M. McCook. Colorado political history is dotted with strange figures, including Clarence Morley, who later in life was convicted of mail fraud and spent five years in the Fort Leavenworth federal penitentiary.

| | | | | | Hi Peter,

One of the best parts of this campaign is seeing who is choosing to stand with us.
50 leaders from across Wisconsin have endorsed our campaign! This coalition includes school board members from across the political spectrum, county board supervisors, a mayor, state assembly members, state senators, and even State Senate Minority Leader Dianne Hesselbein.
These leaders may not agree on everything, but they do agree on this: our campaign is fighting for the right things. We’re working to increase government transparency, protect and strengthen public school funding, and use public power for the public good.
That’s why their support matters. This isn’t about party labels. It’s about trust, credibility, and a shared commitment to moving Wisconsin forward.
Here’s just a handful of some of the amazing people who have endorsed our campaign.
---
[|
---](https://us.list-manage.com/2VqZmcbBhrD?e=f59034ca3e&c2id=997c4beee76ce03997da9db4fe50bd09)
| [You can see the full list of leaders backing our campaign here!](https://us.list-manage.com/IM6PwrQgSHU?e=f59034ca3e&c2id=997c4beee76ce03997da9db4fe50bd09)
---
| |

We’re entering a critical stretch of this race. Over the next several weeks, we need to reach voters across Wisconsin with a clear message: when we work together, we can win a trifecta and move our state forward.
[**If you’re able, please chip in today to help us continue building this people-powered campaign and share our message statewide. $15, $20, more - every contribution helps.**](https://us.list-manage.com/SjbTSwo7hit?e=f59034ca3e&c2id=997c4beee76ce03997da9db4fe50bd09)
Thank you so much for your support!
Best,Dylan

Inside our office, tables are covered in supplies and open boxes. Coworkers are coming together, packing materials, sealing kits, and sending them out the door as fast as possible.

_Above: Activism kits bound for new chapters being packed with Constitutions, chapter handbooks, American flags, and more at TPUSA HQ in Arizona_
---
These boxes aren't sitting around waiting for someone to need them.

They're already claimed. And we don't have extras.

By the time one batch goes out, more requests come in.

Different schools, different students, same situation -- they want to start something, and they're asking us to help them do it.

That's where things stand right now.

We have more students stepping up than we can fully support at the moment.

And I don't say that lightly.

Because for years, the challenge wasn't getting students the tools -- it was getting them to speak up at all. Most kept their heads down.

The Left has spent years trying to convince this generation to sit down, stay quiet, and be ashamed of their country and everything that makes it great.

And for a long time, it worked. But that's all changing.

Now, we're seeing students stand up and push back.

**We saw it clearly at Wheeling High School in the Chicago suburbs -- Charlie's alma mater. **

For the first time, students there launched a Club America chapter. It took months to get approved, but a chapter is finally there.

And now, students are standing outside with signs about free markets and freedom -- not because it's easy, but because they've decided it matters more than staying quiet.

That's not something you can just manufacture. But it is something you can support when it happens.

And it's not isolated growth anymore.

**We 're now working with more than 1,450 college chapters and over 3,400 high school chapters across the country. That's real scale. **

But if you zoom out, there are roughly 27,000 high schools in America.

That means tens of thousands of campuses where the Left still dominates the conversation...

And where students are waiting for someone to help them stand up and speak.

So as much as this has grown, we're still in the early innings of what Charlie actually set out to build.

What's different now is the pace.

**Many states are moving to bring Club America chapters to every high school statewide, including: **

✅ Arkansas
✅ Florida
✅ Idaho
✅ Indiana
✅ Montana
✅ Nebraska
✅ Oklahoma
✅ South Carolina
✅ Texas
✅ Tennessee

That brings us to ten states now taking this seriously -- not just talk, but action.

That kind of expansion doesn't happen slowly.

It stacks quickly -- and it creates pressure behind the scenes to keep up.

Because every new chapter, every new student leader, every new school means more materials, more support, more follow-through.

And right now, that's where we're stretched.

We're not lacking interest or momentum.

We're working to keep up with both.

_So here 's how you can help... _

Right now, there are students ready to step up -- they just need the tools to do it.

**An activism kit puts everything they need directly into their hands: **

✅ Constitutions.
✅ Chapter guides.
✅ Flags.
✅ Materials to organize and lead.

It turns a student who wants to speak up... _into one who actually does. _

And you'll make it possible for us to keep saying yes when a student reaches out and says, "I want to start something here."

**P.S.** Patriot, what you're seeing right now is something we've been working toward for years -- a generation of young Americans who are no longer willing to sit quietly while the Left dominates their schools and culture.

But moments like this don't sustain themselves.

If we don't keep up, we lose ground. It's that simple.

**We need to keep pace with the growth happening right now -- to fund more activism kits, support more chapters, and make sure no student is left standing alone after they decide to speak up. **

clean_body: I wanted you to see this firsthand| | | | | Patriot, I want to give you a picture of what's really happening right now -- not the polished version, but what it actually looks like on the ground. Inside our office, tables are covered in supplies and open boxes. Coworkers are coming together, packing materials, sealing kits, and sending them out the door as fast as possible. Above: Activism kits bound for new chapters being packed with Constitutions, chapter handbooks, American flags, and more at TPUSA HQ in Arizona These boxes aren't sitting around waiting for someone to need them. They're already claimed. And we don't have extras. By the time one batch goes out, more requests come in. Different schools, different students, same situation -- they want to start something, and they're asking us to help them do it. That's where things stand right now. We have more students stepping up than we can fully support at the moment. And I don't say that lightly. Because for years, the challenge wasn't getting students the tools -- it was getting them to speak up at all. Most kept their heads down. The Left has spent years trying to convince this generation to sit down, stay quiet, and be ashamed of their country and everything that makes it great. And for a long time, it worked. But that's all changing. Now, we're seeing students stand up and push back. We saw it clearly at Wheeling High School in the Chicago suburbs -- Charlie's alma mater. For the first time, students there launched a Club America chapter. It took months to get approved, but a chapter is finally there. And now, students are standing outside with signs about free markets and freedom -- not because it's easy, but because they've decided it matters more than staying quiet. That's not something you can just manufacture. But it is something you can support when it happens. And it's not isolated growth anymore. We 're now working with more than 1,450 college chapters and over 3,400 high school chapters across the country. That's real scale. But if you zoom out, there are roughly 27,000 high schools in America. That means tens of thousands of campuses where the Left still dominates the conversation... And where students are waiting for someone to help them stand up and speak. So as much as this has grown, we're still in the early innings of what Charlie actually set out to build. What's different now is the pace. Many states are moving to bring Club America chapters to every high school statewide, including: ✅ Arkansas ✅ Florida ✅ Idaho ✅ Indiana ✅ Montana ✅ Nebraska ✅ Oklahoma ✅ South Carolina ✅ Texas ✅ Tennessee That brings us to ten states now taking this seriously -- not just talk, but action. That kind of expansion doesn't happen slowly. It stacks quickly -- and it creates pressure behind the scenes to keep up. Because every new chapter, every new student leader, every new school means more materials, more support, more follow-through. And right now, that's where we're stretched. We're not lacking interest or momentum. We're working to keep up with both. So here 's how you can help... Right now, there are students ready to step up -- they just need the tools to do it. An activism kit puts everything they need directly into their hands: ✅ Constitutions. ✅ Chapter guides. ✅ Flags. ✅ Materials to organize and lead. It turns a student who wants to speak up... into one who actually does. And you'll make it possible for us to keep saying yes when a student reaches out and says, "I want to start something here." Every activism kit you help sponsor means one more student is ready to lead instead of sitting on the sidelines. That's how we keep saying "yes" when the next student steps forward. That's how this movement actually scales. Because the reality is, the demand is here now. The only question is whether we're equipped to meet it. And that comes down to whether people like you decide to step in and help carry this forward. One final thing: I also wanted to say thank you. If you've supported Turning Point USA before -- whether once or many times -- you've already played a role in building what you're seeing right now. Students finding their voice. More state partnerships. New TPUSA chapters like the one at Charlie's former high school. This kind of momentum doesn't happen without people willing to stand behind it. And we don't take that lightly. I appreciate you taking the time to read this, and for everything you've already done to support this work. | | For Charlie, Andrew Sypher Chief Field OfficerTurning Point USA P.S. Patriot, what you're seeing right now is something we've been working toward for years -- a generation of young Americans who are no longer willing to sit quietly while the Left dominates their schools and culture. But moments like this don't sustain themselves. If we don't keep up, we lose ground. It's that simple. We need to keep pace with the growth happening right now -- to fund more activism kits, support more chapters, and make sure no student is left standing alone after they decide to speak up. If you've already supported Turning Point USA in the past, thank you for carrying this movement forward every single day. If you haven't yet, I'm asking you to step in now. 4940 East Beverly Road Phoenix, Arizona 85044

clean_body: The Supreme Court just released a catastrophic decision to terminate TPS for over 350,000 people from Haiti and Syria. | | | Peter, The Supreme Court just handed down a devastating ruling — clearing the way for this administration to terminate Temporary Protected Status (TPS) for roughly 350,000 people from Haiti and 6,000 people from Syria.1 Since taking office, this administration has moved to end TPS for 14 of the 17 protected countries — putting more than 1.3 million people at risk of detention and deportation and impacting 2.3 million U.S. citizens with loved ones who have TPS. Whether it's this latest court ruling, the slow dismantling of DACA, or the ongoing efforts to redefine birthright citizenship, the goal is the same: push millions of people out of status and redefine who gets to be an American. This is mass delegalization in practice, and citizenship is the only solution. This moment isn’t just about a single program; it's about the stability, safety, and strength of entire communities being jeopardized. Congress faces a clear choice: will they protect the rights of all working people, including immigrants, or will they allow this administration to carry out the largest mass delegalization in modern U.S. history? TPS holders are our neighbors, coworkers, and family members. They’ve built their lives here over decades, and now they face the unthinkable: losing their work permits and the threat of being detained and deported. We’re calling on Congress to deliver citizenship now. **" Recent rain gives Corpus Christi a 9-month reprieve on projected water crisis"** via [The Texas Tribune](https://substack.com/redirect/bb89c252-0ac7-49ff-adc1-4534cdc525e1?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)'s **Colleen DeGuzman** - Corpus Christi got welcome news Tuesday when the city's projected water emergency was delayed to September 2027 after recent rains boosted some of the region's reservoirs.

The city was initially bracing for a Level 1 emergency -- the point when water demand is projected to be six months from exceeding supply -- to surface in December.

Even better for residents and businesses, earlier this year -- when levels at Lake Corpus Christi and Choke Canyon, the city's two main reservoirs, were at their lowest -- the city was preparing for supply to run short this summer.

The latest projection buys the city significantly more time to find new water sources, but city leaders warned that it's not time to slow down. _([ TX TRIB](https://substack.com/redirect/bb89c252-0ac7-49ff-adc1-4534cdc525e1?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg))_

**" Camp Mystic files for bankruptcy after catastrophic Texas floods killed 28 people at the girls' camp"** via AP - [Camp Mystic](https://substack.com/redirect/861320ce-18b2-456c-a98f-87dbc4ae0ac5?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) filed for Chapter 11 bankruptcy reorganization on Wednesday, nearly a year after catastrophic floods killed 25 campers and two teenage counselors at the Christian camp for girls along the Guadalupe River in Texas.

Camp Mystic has been under increasing pressure since the July 4 disaster. Owners had planned to reopen the Texas Hill Country camp this summer for its 100th anniversary [but reversed course](https://substack.com/redirect/5cb2fa9a-a614-458f-9e99-06d0c578ec8d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) in April amid outrage from victims' families and lawmakers. Victims' families filed lawsuits [accusing the camp](https://substack.com/redirect/be11484f-69bd-4d87-80a3-2acf3bd1b494?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) of failing to protect the girls as the powerful floodwaters approached.

Camp Mystic's owner, **Richard Eastland** , also died in the flood.

The camp listed its debt at more than $10 million, according to the filing made in federal bankruptcy court in Houston. An attorney for Camp Mystic has not responded to an email and a phone message seeking comment.

"Bankruptcy will not stop all responsible parties from being held accountable,"**Paul Yetter,** a lawyer who represents multiple families of campers and counselors who died at Camp Mystic, said in a statement. "These innocent girls deserve justice."

For decades, Camp Mystic was a summer staple and an institution for generations of families, who dropped off their girls at the sleepaway camp to ride horses, canoe, fish and attend Bible studies. Other summer camps in Kerr County, west of Austin, did not take on such devastating flooding and in some cases have reopened.

All told, the destructive flooding killed at least 136 people along a several-mile stretch of the river, [raising questions](https://substack.com/redirect/f2ed9328-30c0-421b-81d7-e0ae1e7c64bc?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) about how things went so terribly wrong. _[AP](https://substack.com/redirect/0b04ab21-7d53-4eb1-ae87-0faf273ea84b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)_

**" As New World screwworm reaches Texas, Trump officials race to breed more sterile flies"** via [The Texas Tribune](https://substack.com/redirect/1d22e81f-c30f-4b07-8901-fc398cf70d2d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)'s **Gabby Birenbaum** -- At a Senate Agriculture Committee hearing earlier this month, U.S. Agriculture Secretary**Brooke Rollins** was resolute -- her agency was well-prepared for the New World screwworm, and had kept it at bay for months before the first case was confirmed in a South Texas calf in early June.

As senators asked whether the U.S. Department of Agriculture needed further resources to combat the parasitic fly and if 2025 department cuts had had any impact on the government's capacity to prepare, Rollins maintained that the federal government, from the White House down, was bought in.

"I walked in the Oval Office and I said sir, there is a pretty serious threat to our livestock that's headed our way, and when we need 500 million sterile flies per week, we're only producing 100 million out of Panama, because everyone took their eye off the ball years ago," Rollins said, describing a conversation with President **Donald Trump** in the spring of 2025. "And unfortunately, because of the border policies, it's coming our way. And he said, 'Well, what do you need?'"

What Rollins got was $1.3 billion in emergency funding to tackle New World screwworm, which she said has allowed USDA to move quickly to expand its capacity to tackle the problem. _([ TX TRIB](https://substack.com/redirect/1d22e81f-c30f-4b07-8901-fc398cf70d2d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg))_

**" Chevron plans massive Texas power plant for Microsoft, eyes oilfield wastewater as water source"** via [Houston Chronicle](https://substack.com/redirect/1655d61b-12a8-43e2-a591-d81434063676?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)'s**Amanda Drane** - **Michael Wirth** , Chairman and CEO of Chevron, announced Monday that the company plans to develop a massive power plant in West Texas to fuel a Microsoft data center as a boom in artificial intelligence reshapes the state's oil and gas industry.

The power facility, co-located with the data center in Reeves County, is expected to deliver 2.67 gigawatts of electricity, enough to power roughly 667,500 homes for one hot summer day in Texas.

The Houston oil giant said the project -- its first power plant for AI -- will benefit the Texas economy while mitigating impacts to water resources and the grid. Large Texas oil companies such as Chevron, Exxon Mobil and Diamondback are branching into electricity generation for the first time, cashing in on AI growth as data centers create surging demand for power.

Locating the power facility on the same site as Microsoft's data center enables Chevron to sidestep grid connections and supply it directly with electricity, which will be made onsite using natural gas produced in the Permian Basin and gas turbines, the company said. Chevron said the project will generate more than $10 billion in state and local tax revenue and will support nearly 2,000 jobs. _([ HOU CHRON](https://substack.com/redirect/1655d61b-12a8-43e2-a591-d81434063676?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg))_

**" Majority of Texans oppose data center construction"** via [The Texas Tribune](https://substack.com/redirect/d356ad64-ff7b-4168-902b-0cb3f638ab6c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)'s **Paul Cobler** - A majority of Texans oppose the construction of data centers in their community, including nearly two-thirds of Texans living in rural areas, according to a new poll published Tuesday.

The survey of 1,200 self-reported registered voters conducted by the University of Texas/Texas Politics Project comes as Republican state officials increase their scrutiny of the tech industry and its race to build out the infrastructure needed to support the growing use of artificial intelligence.

"What the data underlines is how much of a problem the business stakeholders that are heavily in favor of [data center development] have on their hands," said **James Henson** , co-director of the poll and head of the Texas Politics Project. "I think the pushback on the issue emerged more quickly and is more widespread than the conventional response to economic development in Texas has historically."

Overall, 56% of those surveyed by the UT poll said they oppose the construction of a data center in their community, while only 29% said they supported the construction. **" Texas water officials seek more funding as crisis worsens, costs soar: 'This is not going to stop'"** via [KXAN](https://substack.com/redirect/4b66ec3a-47f9-4abd-85b2-c9ce5d072c20?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)'s **Eden Shimanek** - Texas water officials pleaded with members of the Texas House Natural Resources committee on Tuesday to provide more funding for water supply projects as project costs skyrocket. Despite the Texas Legislature allocating increased funding to the Texas Water Development Board (TWDB) in 2013, and again last year, water experts are concerned about a lack of funding available for local governments to undertake needed water infrastructure projects.

In 2013, the Legislature passed House Bill 4, which created the State Water Implementation Fund for Texas (SWIFT). This fund had an initial investment of $2 billion and provided communities with low-interest financing to address state water plan projects. Examples of these projects include building new pipelines and conservation efforts. The plan was to use that initial investment as the base of an endowment to build a sustainable fund -- funneling $27 billion towards water infrastructure projects for 50 years.

However, **Temple McKinnon** , water supply planning director for TWDB, says their drafted 2027 five-year State Water Plan far exceeds current funding. "It's an ongoing challenge. We do our absolute best to essentially squeeze as much capacity as we can out of our financial assistance programs, but there is growing demand as evidenced very clearly by the kind of new $174 billion price tag for the State Water Plan," McKinnon told lawmakers Tuesday.

McKinnon clarified that increased costs are attributed to a wide range of factors, including inflationary pressure, labor costs, and materials. Last year, the Texas legislature passed a constitutional amendment to dedicate $1 billion a year towards water infrastructure from 2027 through 2047. The voters of Texas confirmed their support with a constitutional amendment referendum. However, the first funds won't likely be granted until at least 2028. _([ KXAN](https://substack.com/redirect/4b66ec3a-47f9-4abd-85b2-c9ce5d072c20?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg))_
